It periodically activates while attached, adding energy to the branded enemy and causing a pulse that deals damage to the branded enemy and other nearby enemies. The pulse gains area of effect and damage for each energy on the branded enemy, up to 20. All energy is removed from the enemy when the brand is detached.

entries.name: Penance Brand of Conduction
entries.definition: Creates a magical brand which can attach to a nearby enemy. It periodically activates while attached, adding energy to the branded enemy and nearby enemies who do not have energy. When the brand is detached, all enemies with energy are dealt damage.

entries.name: Perforate
entries.definition: Smash the ground to bring forth multiple spears to damage enemies. When in Blood Stance, multiple spikes burst from the ground in sequence, able to hit enemies multiple times. In Sand Stance, the spikes are thrust outwards. Requires a Sword or Axe. You are in Blood Stance by default.

entries.name: Perforate of Duality
entries.definition: Smash the ground to bring forth multiple spears to damage enemies. When in Blood Stance, multiple spikes burst from the ground in sequence, able to hit enemies multiple times. In Sand Stance, the spikes are thrust outwards. Requires a Sword or Axe. You are in Blood Stance by default.

entries.name: Perforate of Bloodshed
entries.definition:
Smash the ground to bring forth multiple spikes from the ground in sequence, able to hit enemies multiple times.
Requires a Sword or Axe.

entries.name: Pestilent Strike
entries.definition: Attacks with your weapon, inflicting a debuff on enemies hit by the strike. If a debuffed enemy dies while poisoned, Pestilent Strike inflicts a secondary chaos damage over time debuff on enemies around them, based on the poisons on the slain enemy. This damage is not affected by your damage modifiers. Requires a Claw or Dagger.

entries.name: Petrified Blood
entries.definition: Applies a buff that protects the lower half of your life, preventing some of the immediate life loss when damaged by hits and applying the loss over time instead. Your life cannot be raised above low life other than by flasks, and while above low life, skills will cost life as well as mana.

entries.name: Phase Run
entries.definition: Gain a buff that makes you faster, harder to detect, and grants Phasing, letting you pass through enemies. Performing any skill replaces this buff with one that boosts melee physical damage of skills you use yourself (it will not apply to your melee skills used by totems). Consumes Frenzy Charges to increase duration.

entries.name: Plague Bearer
entries.definition: Gain an Incubating buff, adding to its Plague Value as you inflict poisons. Use the skill again to begin Infecting, dealing chaos damage over time to nearby enemies until the Plague Value is depleted. Your damage modifiers don't apply to this skill's damage. Using the skill again alternates between Incubating and Infecting.

entries.name: Poacher's Mark
entries.definition: Curses a single enemy, lowering their physical damage reduction, and adding physical damage to all hits against them. Attacking the cursed enemy will grant life and mana, and killing them will grant a frenzy charge. You can only have one Mark at a time.

entries.name: Poisonous Concoction
entries.definition: Throws a bottle that explodes to deal unarmed attack damage in an area and has a chance to poison. Can consume charges from a Life flask to add further damage. Requires an empty main hand, and no off-hand weapon.

entries.name: Poisonous Concoction of Bouncing
entries.definition: Throws a single bottle that releases a burst when it hits the ground, dealing unarmed attack damage in an area with a chance to poison. The skill chains, bouncing randomly to deal damage multiple times. Can consume charges from a Life flask to add further damage. Requires an empty main hand, and no off-hand weapon.

entries.name: Portal
entries.definition: Creates a portal to the current area's town.

entries.name: Power Siphon
entries.definition: Fires your wand to fire a single projectile each at a number of nearby enemies, granting you a power charge if an enemy is killed by, or soon after, the hit.

entries.name: Power Siphon of the Archmage
entries.definition: Fires your wand to fire a single projectile each at a number of nearby enemies, granting you a power charge if an enemy is killed by, or soon after, the hit.

entries.name: Precision
entries.definition: Casts an aura that grants accuracy and critical strike chance to you and your allies.

entries.name: Pride
entries.definition: Casts an aura that causes nearby enemies to take more physical damage.

entries.name: Protective Link
entries.definition: Targets an allied player to apply a buff which links you to them for a duration. While linked, they copy your block chance and recover life when they block. If the target dies while linked, you will also die. This skill cannot be triggered, or used by Totems, Traps, or Mines.

entries.name: Puncture
entries.definition: Punctures enemies with your Bow, causing a bleeding debuff, which will be affected by modifiers to skill duration.

entries.name: Puncture of Shanking
entries.definition: Punctures enemies, causing a bleeding debuff, which will be affected by modifiers to skill duration. Puncture works with daggers, claws or swords.

entries.name: Punishment
entries.definition: Curses all targets in an area, causing them to be debilitated when they hit enemies and increasing damage they take while on low life.

entries.name: Purifying Flame
entries.definition: A wave of divine fire deals damage in a line, then creates Consecrated Ground and deals damage in an area around the targeted location. A larger shockwave then expands outwards, damaging enemies standing on Consecrated Ground that were not already hit.

entries.name: Purifying Flame of Revelations
entries.definition: A wave of divine fire deals damage in a line, then creates Consecrated Ground and deals damage in an area around the targeted location. A larger shockwave then expands outwards, damaging enemies standing on Consecrated Ground that were not already hit.

entries.name: Purity of Elements
entries.definition: Casts an aura that grants elemental resistances and elemental ailment immunity to you and your allies.

entries.name: Purity of Fire
entries.definition: Casts an aura that grants fire resistance to you and your allies.

entries.name: Purity of Ice
entries.definition: Casts an aura that grants cold resistance to you and your allies.

entries.name: Purity of Lightning
entries.definition: Casts an aura that grants lightning resistance to you and your allies.

entries.name: Pyroclast Mine
entries.definition: Throws a mine that deals damage in an area when detonated, then launches fiery projectiles that rain down around it, each exploding to deal damage in a smaller area. Placed mines apply a fire exposure aura to nearby enemies.

entries.name: Pyroclast Mine of Sabotage
entries.definition: Throws a mine that deals damage in an area when detonated, then launches fiery projectiles that rain down around it, each exploding to deal damage in a smaller area. Placed mines apply a fire exposure aura to nearby enemies.

entries.name: Steelskin
entries.definition: Applies a buff which can take some of the damage from hits for you before being depleted. Shares a cooldown with other Guard skills.

entries.name: Quickstep
entries.definition: Performs a series of quick teleports towards a targeted location, stopping if you would overlap with monsters or terrain. If using the "Attack in Place" option, the direction is reversed. Shares a cooldown with other Blink skills. Cannot be supported.

entries.name: Rage Vortex
entries.definition: Spin with a sword or axe to deal damage in an area around you. Sacrifices some rage to send a ragestorm forward. While enemies are inside it, the ragestorm will slow its movement and repeatedly deal attack damage based on your attack speed.

entries.name: Rage Vortex of Berserking
entries.definition: Spin with a sword or axe to deal damage in an area around you. If you have at least 10 rage, create a ragestorm attached to you that repeatedly deals attack damage to enemies inside based on your attack speed. The ragestorm consumes rage at an accelerating rate, and ends if you run out.

entries.name: Rain of Arrows
entries.definition: Fires multiple arrows into the air, to land in sequence after a delay, starting at the targeted location and spreading outwards in all directions. Each arrow deals damage in an area around it. Half of the arrows will land directly on targets if there are targets in their range.

entries.name: Rain of Arrows of Artillery
entries.definition: Fires multiple arrows into the air, to land in sequence after a delay, starting in front of you and proceeding in a line in the direction of the target. Each arrow deals damage in an area around it.

entries.name: Rain of Arrows of Saturation
entries.definition: Fires multiple arrows into the air, to slowly land in sequence after a delay, starting at the targeted location and spreading outwards in all directions. Each arrow deals damage in an area around it. Half of the arrows will land directly on targets if there are targets in their range.

entries.name: Raise Spectre
entries.definition: Raises a spectral version of a defeated foe as a minion to fight for you in battle.

entries.name: Raise Spectre of Transience
entries.definition: Raises a spectral version of a defeated foe as a temporary minion to fight for you in battle for a duration.

entries.name: Raise Zombie
entries.definition: Raises a zombie minion from a corpse, which will follow you and attack enemies with a melee strike.

entries.name: Raise Zombie of Slamming
entries.definition: Raises a zombie minion from a corpse, which will follow you and attack enemies with a melee strike and an area of effect slam.

entries.name: Raise Zombie of Falling
entries.definition: Raises necromantic energies into the sky above a targeted location, where they coalesce into a zombie minion. The minion then attacks by falling to the ground, causing an impact that deals damage in an area. The zombie cannot survive the impact.

entries.name: Rallying Cry
entries.definition: Performs a warcry, taunting nearby enemies to attack the user and exerting subsequent attacks. Nearby allies gain a buff based on the damage of your weapon.

entries.name: Reap
entries.definition: A bloody scythe swipes across a selected area, applying a physical damage over time debuff and hitting enemies with physical damage. If any survive, you gain a blood charge which raises the damage and cost of the skill. Players can have 5 maximum blood charges.

entries.name: Reap of Butchery
entries.definition: A bloody scythe swipes around you, applying a physical damage over time debuff and hitting enemies with physical damage. If any survive, you gain a blood charge which raises the damage and cost of the skill. Players can have 5 maximum blood charges.

entries.name: Reave
entries.definition: Attacks an area in front of you. Each Reave that hits an enemy grants stages, which you will begin to lose after a short period without hitting anything. Only works with Daggers, Claws, and One-Handed Swords.

entries.name: Reave of Refraction
entries.definition: Attacks an area in front of you. Each Reave that hits an enemy grants stages, which you will begin to lose after a short period without hitting anything. Only works with Daggers, Claws, and One-Handed Swords.

entries.name: Rejuvenation Totem
entries.definition: Summons a totem that has an aura which regenerates life for you and your nearby allies.

entries.name: Righteous Fire
entries.definition: Engulfs you in magical fire that rapidly burns you and nearby enemies. Your spell damage is substantially increased while under this effect. The effect ends when you have 1 life remaining.

entries.name: Righteous Fire of Arcane Devotion
entries.definition: Engulfs you in magical fire that rapidly burns you and nearby enemies. Your cast speed is substantially increased while under this effect. The effect ends when you have 1 life remaining. Requires mana.

entries.name: Rolling Magma
entries.definition: Lob a fiery orb that deals area damage as it hits the ground. The skill chains, bouncing forward to deal damage multiple times.

entries.name: Scorching Ray
entries.definition: Unleash a beam of fire that burns enemies it touches. Remaining in the beam raises the burning, adding a portion of the beam's damage in stages. Inflicts Fire Exposure at maximum stages. Enemies who leave the beam continue to burn for a duration. Increasing cast speed also increases the rate at which the beam turns.

entries.name: Scorching Ray of Immolation
entries.definition: Unleash a beam of fire that burns enemies it touches. Remaining in the beam raises the burning, adding a portion of the beam's damage in stages. Enemies who leave the beam continue to burn for a duration. Increasing cast speed also increases the rate at which the beam turns.

entries.name: Scourge Arrow
entries.definition: Channel to infuse an arrow with chaos, gaining stages while it is held. Release to fire it, leaving spore pods in its wake. Each spore pod blooms, firing thorn arrows, which travel for a short time before dissipating. Modifiers that cause additional projectiles to be fired will only apply to the initial arrows, and the spore pods will be divided between those arrows.

entries.name: Scourge Arrow of Menace
entries.definition: Fire an arrow that leaves a spore pod in its wake. The spore pod blooms, firing thorn arrows, which travel for a short time before dissipating. Modifiers that cause additional projectiles to be fired will only apply to the initial arrows, each of which leaves its own spore pod.

entries.name: Searing Bond
entries.definition: Summons a totem that casts a beam of fire at you and each other totem you control, dealing burning damage to enemies caught in the beam. Enemies near either end of a beam also suffer burning damage.

entries.name: Searing Bond of Detonation
entries.definition: Summons a totem that casts a beam of fire at you and each other totem you control, dealing burning damage to enemies caught in the beam. Enemies near either end of a beam also suffer burning damage. Reaching maximum active totem count will cause all totems from this skill to detonate, applying the same burning damage for a duration.

entries.name: Seismic Cry
entries.definition: Performs a warcry, taunting nearby enemies to attack the user and exerting subsequent slam attacks. The user and nearby allies gain a buff that increases their armour and stun threshold.

entries.name: Seismic Trap
entries.definition: Throws a trap which, once triggered, repeatedly releases a number of waves for a duration. Each wave deals damage in a series of small bursts in a line, ending with a larger burst.

entries.name: Seismic Trap of Swells
entries.definition: Throws a trap which, once triggered, releases a number of waves. Each wave deals damage in a series of small bursts in a line, ending with a larger burst.

entries.name: Shattering Steel
entries.definition: Swing an Axe or Sword, firing projectiles which shatter on impact or soon after being launched, dealing area damage in front of where they shatter.

entries.name: Shattering Steel of Ammunition
entries.definition: Swing an Axe or Sword, consuming Steel Shards to gain a Steel Ward that protects you for a duration, and fire projectiles which shatter on impact or soon after being launched, dealing area damage in front of where they shatter. Steel Shards are gained with the Call of Steel Skill.

entries.name: Shield Charge
entries.definition: Charges at a targeted location or enemy, pushing away enemies in your path and repeatedly dealing off-hand damage in a small area in front of you. You deal damage in a larger area when you reach the target. The further you travel, the more damage you deal, and the greater your chance of stunning enemies.

entries.name: Shield Crush
entries.definition: Swipe your shield, dealing area damage in three waves in front of you. Enemies can be hit by two of the waves where they overlap.

entries.name: Shield Crush of the Chieftain
entries.definition: Swipe your shield, dealing area damage in three waves in front of you. Enemies can be hit by two of the waves where they overlap.

entries.name: Shield of Light
entries.definition: Retaliate against a blocked hit with a sweep of your Shield, unleashing a wave of light in a cone in front of you. Additional waves will also emanate from allies in a radius around the first target struck, towards that target.

entries.name: Shock Nova
entries.definition: Casts a ring of Lightning around you, followed by a larger Lightning nova. Each effect hits enemies caught in their area with Lightning Damage.

entries.name: Shock Nova of Procession
entries.definition: Casts a ring of Lightning around you, followed by a larger Lightning nova. Each effect hits enemies caught in their area with Lightning Damage. This then repeats, with each repeat offset from the previous in the direction you target.

entries.name: Shockwave Totem
entries.definition: Summons a totem that shakes the earth around it, knocking back and damaging nearby enemies

entries.name: Shockwave Totem of Authority
entries.definition: Summons a totem that shakes the earth around you, damaging enemies.

entries.name: Shrapnel Ballista
entries.definition: Summons a ballista totem that fires multiple arrows with extreme force, breaking them apart into shrapnel. Enemies can be hit by multiple arrows from the same attack. Requires a Bow.

entries.name: Shrapnel Ballista of Steel
entries.definition: Summons a ballista totem that consumes your Steel Shards to fire multiple arrows with extreme force, breaking them apart into shrapnel. Enemies can be hit by multiple arrows from the same attack. Requires a Bow. Steel Shards are gained with the Call of Steel Skill.

entries.name: Siege Ballista
entries.definition: Summons a ballista totem that attacks with piercing arrows. Requires a Bow.

entries.name: Siege Ballista of Splintering
entries.definition:
Summons a ballista totem that attacks with forking arrows.
Requires a Bow.

entries.name: Siege Ballista of Trarthus
entries.definition: Summons a ring of ballista totems around a targeted location. These ballistae fire once at the targeted location and then expire. Requires a Bow.

entries.name: Sigil of Power
entries.definition: Places a Sigil on the ground, which grants a buff to you and allies in the area around it for a duration. The Sigil gains stages as you spend mana in its area, making the buff more powerful. You can only have one Sigil of Power at a time.

entries.name: Siphoning Trap
entries.definition: Throws a trap that applies debuff beams to a number of nearby enemies for a duration. The beams chill enemies and deal cold damage over time. A beam is also applied to you, granting life and mana regeneration based on the number of debuff beams affecting enemies.

entries.name: Siphoning Trap of Pain
entries.definition: Throws a trap that applies debuff beams to a number of nearby enemies for a duration. The beams chill enemies and deal cold damage over time.

entries.name: Smite
entries.definition: Performs a melee attack, and causes lightning to strike a nearby enemy, dealing damage in an area. Each target can only be hit once by this skill. Hitting an enemy grants an aura for a duration. Requires a Sword, Axe, Mace, Sceptre, Staff or Unarmed.

entries.name: Smite of Divine Judgement
entries.definition: Performs a melee attack, and causes lightning to strike nearby enemies, dealing damage in an area. Each target can only be hit once by this skill. Requires a Sword, Axe, Mace, Sceptre, Staff or Unarmed.

entries.name: Smoke Mine
entries.definition: Throws a mine that will teleport you to it when detonated. It covers both your escape and arrival with a cloud of smoke that blinds enemies, and gives you a temporary buff to movement speed. Shares a cooldown with other Blink skills.

entries.name: Snipe
entries.definition: Channel to charge up your bow, gaining stages. Release to trigger one supported bow skill for each stage gained. If there are no supported skills, but at least one stage was gained, this skill will fire its own arrow instead. Cannot be used by Totems.

entries.name: Sniper's Mark
entries.definition: Curses a single enemy, increasing the damage they take from projectiles, and making projectiles split when hitting them, to hit other targets around them. You can only have one Mark at a time.

entries.name: Somatic Shell
entries.definition: Fire a damaging projectile from your wand which aims itself towards an enemy and applies a shell to the first enemy struck. Damage from hits against that target is taken from the shell first. If fully depleted, the shell will explode, dealing area damage and firing a projectile at another target to apply a new shell to it. If multiple projectiles are fired by an exploding shell, only the first one to hit a target can apply a shell.

entries.name: Soul Link
entries.definition: Targets an allied player to apply a buff which links you to them for a duration. While linked, your Energy Shield will intercept some of the damage they would take. If the target dies while linked, you will also die. This skill cannot be triggered, or used by Totems, Traps, or Mines.

entries.name: Soulrend
entries.definition: Fires a projectile that turns towards enemies in front of it, damaging and piercing through those it hits, and leeching some of that damage as energy shield. As the projectile travels, it repeatedly applies a short but powerful chaos damage over time debuff to each enemy in an area around it.

entries.name: Soulrend of Reaping
entries.definition: Fires a projectile that deals chaos damage to enemies it hits and leeches some of that damage as energy shield.

entries.name: Soulrend of the Spiral
entries.definition: Fires a series of projectiles in a spiral that turn towards enemies in front of them, damaging and piercing through those they hit, and leeching some of that damage as energy shield. As the projectiles travel, they repeatedly apply a short but powerful chaos damage over time debuff to each enemy in an area around them.

entries.name: Spark
entries.definition: Launches unpredictable sparks that move randomly until they hit an enemy or expire.

entries.name: Spark of the Nova
entries.definition: Launches unpredictable sparks in all directions that move randomly until they hit an enemy or expire.

entries.name: Spark of Unpredictability
entries.definition: Launches unpredictable sparks with that move randomly with large differences in speed and distance until they hit an enemy or expire.

entries.name: Spectral Helix
entries.definition: Throws a spectral copy of your melee weapon. It spins around while flying in a large spiral, damaging enemies in its path, and bouncing if it collides with walls.

entries.name: Spectral Helix of Trarthus
entries.definition: Throws a trap which, once triggered, fires a spectral copy of your melee weapon. It spins around while flying in a large spiral, damaging enemies in its path, and bouncing if it collides with walls. If dual wielding, each Trap thrown will randomly use either the main hand or off hand weapon.

entries.name: Spectral Shield Throw
entries.definition: Throws a spectral copy of your shield as a projectile which cannot pierce, and deals off-hand damage augmented by the defences of the shield. When it collides with something it will shatter, launching a number of smaller shards as projectiles in all directions. Modifiers that cause additional projectiles to be fired will add more shards, not more copies of the shield.

entries.name: Spectral Shield Throw of Shattering
entries.definition: Throws a spectral copy of your shield as a projectile which cannot pierce, and deals off-hand damage augmented by the evasion of the shield. When it collides with something it will shatter, launching a number of smaller shards as projectiles in all directions. Modifiers that cause additional projectiles to be fired will add more shards, not more copies of the shield.

entries.name: Spectral Shield Throw of Trarthus
entries.definition: Throws a spectral copy of your shield as a piercing projectile which deals off-hand damage augmented by the defences of the shield. When it reaches the targeted location it will hover in place, repeatedly firing a number of smaller shards as projectiles in all directions. The rate at which it releases shards will increase until all shards have been fired. Modifiers that cause additional projectiles to be fired will add more shards, not more copies of the shield.

entries.name: Spectral Throw
entries.definition: Throws a spectral copy of your melee weapon. It flies out and then returns to you, in a spinning attack that damages enemies in its path.

entries.name: Spectral Throw of Materialising
entries.definition: Throws an intangible spectral copy of your melee weapon. It flies out and then becomes tangible as it returns to you, in a spinning attack that only hits and damages enemies while returning.

entries.name: Spectral Throw of Trarthus
entries.definition: Throws a trap which, once triggered, fires many spectral copies of your melee weapon. They fly out in all directions and then return to where the trap triggered, in a spinning attack that damages enemies in their path. If dual wielding, each Trap thrown will randomly use either the main hand or off hand weapon.

entries.name: Spellslinger
entries.definition: Reserves mana based on the supported spells to cause those spells to trigger when you fire projectiles from a wand attack.

entries.name: Spirit Offering
entries.definition: Consumes a corpse, granting increased critical strike chance and additional critical strike multiplier to your minions. The skill consumes other nearby corpses, increasing the duration for each corpse consumed.

entries.name: Split Arrow
entries.definition: Fires multiple arrows at different targets.

entries.name: Split Arrow of Splitting
entries.definition: Fires an arrow that splits to hit different targets.

entries.name: Splitting Steel
entries.definition: Fire a single projectile that splits on impact or at the targeted location, dealing area damage when it splits and again when the split projectiles explode at the end of their flight. Projectiles from this skill cannot return. Requires a Sword or Axe.

entries.name: Splitting Steel of Ammunition
entries.definition: Consume Steel Shards to fire a single projectile that splits on impact or at the targeted location, dealing area damage when it splits and again when the split projectiles explode at the end of their flight. Projectiles from this skill cannot return. Requires a Sword or Axe. Steel Shards are gained with the Call of Steel Skill.

entries.name: Static Strike
entries.definition: Attack with a melee weapon, gaining static energy for a duration if you hit an enemy. While you have static energy, you'll frequently hit a number of nearby enemies with beams, dealing attack damage.

entries.name: Static Strike of Gathering Lightning
entries.definition: Attack with a melee weapon, gaining a Gathering Lightning buff for a duration if you hit an enemy. While you have Gathering Lightning, attacks with this skill will cause chaining beams of lightning, which chain additional times the more Gathering Lightning you have.

entries.name: Stormbind
entries.definition: Channel to spread runes on the ground in a growing pattern. The runes fade away after a duration, or will be immediately removed and deal damage in a circular area when detonated by Rune Blast. Enemies standing on the runes are Hindered, reducing their movement speed.

entries.name: Stormbind of Teleportation
entries.definition: Channel to spread runes on the ground in a growing pattern. The runes fade away after a duration, or will be immediately removed and deal damage in a circular area when detonated by Rune Blast. Enemies standing on the runes are Hindered, reducing their movement speed.

entries.name: Storm Brand
entries.definition: Creates a magical brand which can attach to a nearby enemy. It periodically activates while attached, firing beams which deal damage to nearby enemies and those around them. The brand will detach if the enemy dies.

entries.name: Storm Brand of Indecision
entries.definition: Creates a magical brand which can attach to a nearby enemy. It periodically activates while attached, firing a beam which deals damage to the branded enemy and those around it. The brand will detach if the enemy dies.

entries.name: Storm Burst
entries.definition: Unleash orbs of energy while you channel that repeatedly jump towards the targeted location until their duration expires, dealing damage in a small area after each jump. When you stop channelling, all remaining orbs explode, dealing higher damage in a larger area.

entries.name: Storm Burst of Repulsion
entries.definition: Unleash orbs of energy while you channel that repeatedly jump away from the targeted location until their duration expires, dealing damage in a small area after each jump. When you stop channelling, all remaining orbs explode, dealing higher damage in a larger area.

entries.name: Storm Call
entries.definition: Sets a marker at a location. After a short duration, lightning strikes the marker, dealing damage around it and causing lightning strikes at any other markers you've cast.

entries.name: Storm Call of Trarthus
entries.definition: Sets a marker at a location. After a short duration, a bolt strikes the marker, dealing physical damage around it and causing bolts to strike at any other markers you've cast. Bolt impacts will leave behind a pool of boiling blood, which deals physical damage over time to enemies within it for a secondary duration.

entries.name: Storm Rain
entries.definition: Fires an arrow into the air to land at a targeted location, dealing area damage. The arrow sticks in the ground where it lands, and periodically fires a beam of lightning to another arrow near it, dealing area damage between them.

entries.name: Storm Rain of the Conduit
entries.definition: Fires an arrow into the air to land at a targeted location, dealing area damage. The arrow sticks in the ground where it lands, and periodically fires a beam of lightning to you, dealing area damage between the arrow and you.

entries.name: Storm Rain of the Fence
entries.definition: Fires an arrow into the air to land at a targeted location, dealing area damage. The arrow sticks in the ground where it lands, and periodically fires a beam of lightning to another arrow near it, dealing area damage between them.

entries.name: Stormblast Mine
entries.definition: Throws a mine that deals damage in an area when detonated.

entries.name: Summon Carrion Golem
entries.definition: Summons a Carrion Golem that grants added physical damage for your non-golem minions. The Carrion Golem attacks with a series of slashes that increase in speed and damage, as well as a cascade of bone spikes, and deals more damage for each of your non-golem minions near it.

entries.name: Summon Carrion Golem of Hordes
entries.definition: Summons a Carrion Golem. The Carrion Golem attacks with a series of slashes that increase in speed and damage, as well as a cascade of bone spikes.

entries.name: Summon Carrion Golem of Scavenging
entries.definition: Summons a Carrion Golem. The Carrion Golem attacks with a series of slashes that increase in speed and damage, can consume corpses to heal itself and gain the ability to unleash a devastating cascade of bone spikes, and deals more damage for each of your non-golem minions near it.

entries.name: Summon Chaos Golem
entries.definition: Summons a Chaos Golem that grants you damage over time and chaos resistance. The Chaos Golem can cast a damage over time Chaos aura and a cascade of Chaos spikes in addition to its melee attack.

entries.name: Summon Chaos Golem of Hordes
entries.definition: Summons a Chaos Golem. The Chaos Golem can cast a damage over time Chaos aura and a cascade of Chaos spikes in addition to its melee attack.

entries.name: Summon Chaos Golem of the Maelström
aliases: Summon Chaos Golem of the Maelström
entries.definition: Summons a Chaos Golem. The Chaos Golem can cast a powerful damage over time Chaos aura that Withers enemies in addition to its melee attack.

entries.name: Summon Flame Golem
entries.definition: Summons a Flame Golem that grants you increased Damage and Area of Effect. The Flame Golem can cast a fire spray, a wave of fire damage, and an explosive arcing projectile.

entries.name: Summon Flame Golem of Hordes
entries.definition: Summons a Flame Golem. The Flame Golem can cast a fire spray, a wave of fire damage, and an explosive arcing projectile.

entries.name: Summon Flame Golem of the Meteor
aliases: Summon Flame Golem of the Meteor
entries.definition: Summons a Flame Golem. When summoned, the Flame Golem attacks by falling from the sky, dealing fire damage in an area and leaving burning ground around the impact. After landing, it can cast a fire spray and a wave of fire damage.

entries.name: Summon Holy Relic
entries.definition: Summon a Holy Relic that stays near you. When you hit an enemy with an attack, the Holy Relic triggers a nova spell with a short cooldown, that deals physical damage to enemies and grants life regeneration to allies in an area around it. This life regeneration is higher when applied to minions.

entries.name: Summon Holy Relic of Conviction
entries.definition: Summon a Holy Relic that stays near you. When you hit an enemy with an attack, the Holy Relic triggers a spell with a short cooldown, that deals physical damage to enemies in an area around a nearby enemy.

entries.name: Summon Ice Golem
entries.definition: Summons an Ice Golem that grants you increased Critical Strike Chance and Accuracy. The Ice Golem can use an icy barrage spell and a chilling spinning attack in addition to its melee attack.

entries.name: Summon Ice Golem of Hordes
entries.definition: Summons an Ice Golem. The Ice Golem can use an icy barrage spell and a chilling spinning attack in addition to its melee attack.

entries.name: Summon Ice Golem of Shattering
entries.definition: Summons an Ice Golem. The Ice Golem can use an icy barrage spell and a chilling spinning attack in addition to its melee attack. If reduced to low life it will trigger a spell that destroys itself to deal area damage and fire icy projectiles in a circle.

entries.name: Summon Lightning Golem
entries.definition: Summons a Lightning Golem that grants you increased attack and cast speed, and mana regeneration. The Lightning Golem fires a projectile spell, creates orbs of Lightning that zap nearby enemies, and casts a temporary aura that grants added Lightning Damage to spells and attacks used by the Golem and its nearby allies.

entries.name: Summon Lightning Golem of Hordes
entries.definition: Summons a Lightning Golem. The Lightning Golem fires a projectile spell, creates orbs of Lightning that zap nearby enemies, and casts a temporary aura that grants added Lightning Damage to spells and attacks used by the Golem and its nearby allies.

entries.name: Summon Raging Spirit
entries.definition: Summons a short-lived flaming skull that rushes at nearby enemies and attacks them rapidly, converting all its physical damage to fire. Enemies will not directly engage these spirits, and can pass through them.

entries.name: Summon Raging Spirit of Enormity
entries.definition: Summons a short-lived flaming skull that rushes at nearby enemies and attacks them rapidly, converting all its physical damage to fire. Enemies will not directly engage these spirits, and can pass through them.

entries.name: Summon Reaper
entries.definition: Summons a powerful Reaper which uses a variety of slashing area attacks. The Reaper's presence weakens your other minions, and it will consume them to temporarily empower and heal itself. Using this skill while the Reaper is already summoned causes it to dash to the targeted location and perform a powerful attack.

entries.name: Summon Reaper of Revenants
entries.definition: Summons a Reaper which uses a variety of slashing area attacks. The presence of any Reapers weakens your other non-Reaper minions, and Reapers will consume them to temporarily empower and heal themselves.

entries.name: Summon Reaper of Eviscerating
entries.definition: Summons a powerful Reaper which passively follows you without attacking enemies. The Reaper's presence weakens your other minions, and it will consume them to temporarily empower and heal itself. Using this skill while the Reaper is already summoned causes it to dash to the targeted location and perform a powerful attack. Cannot be triggered, supported by Spell Echo or Unleash, or used by Totems, Traps, or Mines.

entries.name: Summon Skeletons
entries.definition: Summon Skeleton Warrior minions at the targeted location. They use a melee attack and die after a duration. If made aggressive, Skeleton Warriors will also dash towards nearby enemies.

entries.name: Summon Skeletons of Archers
entries.definition: Summon Skeleton Archer minions at the targeted location. They fire arrows and die after a duration.

entries.name: Summon Skeletons of Mages
entries.definition: Summon Skeleton Mage minions of random elemental types at the targeted location. They cast projectile spells based on their element, and die after a duration.

entries.name: Summon Skitterbots
entries.definition: Summon a Chilling Skitterbot and a Shocking Skitterbot, which will trigger your traps and detonate your mines. Mines detonated by Skitterbots will re-arm and can then be detonated again. The Skitterbots grant you more trap and mine damage, and cannot be targeted or damaged.

entries.name: Summon Stone Golem
entries.definition: Summons a Stone Golem that grants you life regeneration and defences. In addition to its melee attack, the Stone Golem uses a rolling charge and a powerful slam that can taunt enemies.

entries.name: Summon Stone Golem of Hordes
entries.definition: Summons a Stone Golem. In addition to its melee attack, the Stone Golem uses a rolling charge and a powerful slam that can taunt enemies.

entries.name: Summon Stone Golem of Safeguarding
entries.definition: Summons a Stone Golem that takes a portion of the melee damage you recieve from enemy hits from its life before yours. In addition to its melee attack, the Stone Golem uses a rolling charge and a powerful slam that can taunt enemies.

entries.name: Sunder
entries.definition: Slams the ground, creating a slow wave of churning terrain that damages enemies in a sequence of areas in front of you. A number of enemies hit by the wave will release a shockwave, damaging other enemies around them. Using the skill again will stop the previous wave. Requires a Mace, Sceptre, Axe, Staff or Unarmed.

entries.name: Sunder of Earthbreaking
entries.definition: Slams the ground, creating a wave of churning terrain that damages enemies in a sequence of areas in front of you. A number of enemies hit by the wave will release a shockwave, damaging other enemies around them. Requires a Mace, Sceptre, Axe, Staff or Unarmed.

entries.name: Sunder of Trarthus
entries.definition: Slams the ground, creating a slow wave of churning terrain that damages enemies in a sequence of areas in front of you. A number of enemies hit by the wave will release a shockwave, damaging other enemies around them. Using the skill again will stop the previous wave. When the wave reaches a target or terrain, it can restart aiming towards an enemy, if one is in range. Requires a Mace, Sceptre, Axe, Staff or Unarmed.

entries.name: Added Chaos Damage
entries.definition: Supports any skill that hits enemies.

entries.name: Added Cold Damage
entries.definition: Supports any skill that hits enemies.

entries.name: Added Fire Damage
entries.definition: Supports any skill that hits enemies.

entries.name: Added Lightning Damage
entries.definition: Supports any skill that hits enemies.

entries.name: Additional Accuracy
entries.definition: Supports attack skills.

entries.name: Advanced Traps
entries.definition: Supports skills which throw traps.

entries.name: Ancestral Call
entries.definition: Supports melee strike skills, causing them to also strike at extra targets simultaneously. The extra targets must be a minimum distance from the user. If supporting a minion attack skill, the minion's skills will not also strike extra targets. Cannot support Vaal skills or triggered skills.

entries.name: Annihilation
entries.definition: Supports any skill that hits enemies.

entries.name: Arcane Surge
entries.definition: Each supported spell will track how much mana you spend on it, granting a buff when the total mana spent reaches a threshold. Cannot support skills used by totems, traps, mines or skills with a reservation.

entries.name: Archmage
entries.definition: Supports spell skills that deal damage with hits and have no reservation. Cannot support arcane skills, Brand skills, Orb skills, Vaal skills, or skills used by totems, traps or mines. Cannot modify the skills of minions.

entries.name: Arrogance
entries.definition: Supports any non-blessing skill with a reservation.

entries.name: Arrow Nova
entries.definition: Supports bow attack skills that fire arrows forwards as projectiles. These skills will instead fire a payload arrow into the air to land at a targeted location. The supported skills' arrows will then fire out in a circle from where it lands. Cannot support skills that already fire arrows into the air, channelled skills, or skills that create Minions.

entries.name: Awakened Added Chaos Damage
entries.definition: Supports any skill that hits enemies.

entries.name: Awakened Added Cold Damage
entries.definition: Supports any skill that hits enemies.

entries.name: Awakened Added Fire Damage
entries.definition: Supports any skill that hits enemies.

entries.name: Awakened Added Lightning Damage
entries.definition: Supports any skill that hits enemies.

entries.name: Awakened Ancestral Call
entries.definition: Supports melee strike skills, causing them to also strike at extra targets simultaneously. The extra targets must be a minimum distance from the user. If supporting a minion attack skill, the minion's skills will not also strike extra targets. Cannot support Vaal skills or triggered skills.

entries.name: Awakened Arrow Nova
entries.definition: Supports bow attack skills that fire arrows forwards as projectiles. These skills will instead fire a payload arrow into the air to land at a targeted location. The supported skills' arrows will then fire out in a circle from where it lands. Cannot support skills that already fire arrows into the air, channelled skills, or skills that create Minions.

entries.name: Awakened Blasphemy
entries.definition: Supports hex curse skills, turning them into auras that will apply their effect to all enemies in an area around you.

entries.name: Awakened Brutality
entries.definition: Supports any skill that deals damage.

entries.name: Awakened Burning Damage
entries.definition: Supports any skill that hits enemies, or can deal burning damage directly.

entries.name: Awakened Cast On Critical Strike
entries.definition: Must support both an attack skill and a spell skill to work. The attack skill will trigger a spell when it critically strikes an enemy. Cannot support totems, traps, or mines. Vaal skills, channelling skills, and skills with a reservation cannot be triggered.

entries.name: Awakened Cast While Channelling
entries.definition: Must support both a channelling skill and a non-channelling spell skill to work. The channelling skill will trigger a spell periodically while channelling. Cannot support skills used by totems, traps, or mines. Vaal skills and skills with a reservation cannot be triggered.

entries.name: Awakened Chain
entries.definition: Supports projectile skills, and any other skills that chain.

entries.name: Awakened Cold Penetration
entries.definition: Supports any skill that hits enemies, making those hits penetrate enemy cold resistance.

entries.name: Awakened Controlled Destruction
entries.definition: Supports attack skills, or spell skills that deal damage.

entries.name: Awakened Deadly Ailments
entries.definition: Supports any skill that hits enemies.

entries.name: Awakened Elemental Damage with Attacks
entries.definition: Supports attack skills.

entries.name: Awakened Elemental Focus
entries.definition: Supports any skill that hits or burns enemies, or inflicts elemental ailments.

entries.name: Awakened Empower
entries.definition: Supports any skill gem. Once this gem reaches level 2 or above, will raise the level of supported gems. Cannot support skills that don't come from gems.

entries.name: Awakened Enhance
entries.definition: Supports any skill gem. Once this gem reaches level 2 or above, will raise the quality of supported gems. Cannot support skills that don't come from gems.

entries.name: Awakened Enlighten
entries.definition: Supports any skill gem. Once this gem reaches level 2 or above, will apply a cost & reservation multiplier to supported gems. Cannot support skills that don't come from gems.

entries.name: Awakened Fire Penetration
entries.definition: Supports any skill that hits enemies, making those hits penetrate enemy fire resistance.

entries.name: Awakened Fork
entries.definition: Supports projectile skills, making their projectiles fork into two projectiles the first two times they hit an enemy and don't pierce it.

entries.name: Awakened Generosity
entries.definition: Supports aura skills that affect you and allies, increasing the aura's effect on allies, but preventing it from affecting you at all. Cannot support curse auras, or other auras that only affect enemies. Cannot support skills used by totems. Cannot modify the skills of minions.

entries.name: Awakened Greater Multiple Projectiles
entries.definition: Supports projectile skills.

entries.name: Awakened Hextouch
entries.definition: Must support both a skill that hits enemies, and a hex curse skill to work. The hex will be applied when enemies are hit by the other skill. Cannot support totems, traps, or mines. Minions cannot apply hexes this way.

entries.name: Awakened Increased Area of Effect
entries.definition: Supports any skill with an area of effect.

entries.name: Awakened Lightning Penetration
entries.definition: Supports any skill that hits enemies, making those hits penetrate enemy lightning resistance.

entries.name: Awakened Melee Physical Damage
entries.definition: Supports melee attack skills.

entries.name: Awakened Melee Splash
entries.definition: Supports melee strike skills, causing their melee strike to deal splash damage around each target hit.

entries.name: Awakened Minion Damage
entries.definition: Supports skills which create Minions.

entries.name: Awakened Multistrike
entries.definition: Supports melee attack skills, making them repeat three times when used, targeting a random enemy each time. Cannot support Vaal skills, channelling skills, travel skills, retaliation skills or triggered skills.

entries.name: Awakened Spell Cascade
entries.definition: Supports spell skills that apply an effect to an area around a targeted location. Cannot support Vaal skills or skills used by totems, traps, or mines. Cannot modify the skills of minions.

entries.name: Awakened Spell Echo
entries.definition: Supports spell skills, making them repeat when cast. Cannot support Vaal skills, totem skills, channelling skills, triggered skills, instant skills, retaliation skills, blink skills, or skills with a reservation.

entries.name: Awakened Swift Affliction
entries.definition: Supports any skill that has a duration, or can hit enemies to inflict ailments on them.

entries.name: Awakened Unbound Ailments
entries.definition: Supports any skill that hits enemies or inflicts ailments

entries.name: Awakened Unleash
entries.definition: Supports spell skills, making their effect reoccur when cast. Cannot support skills with cooldowns, triggered skills, Brand skills, Vaal skills, channelling skills, skills with a reservation, or skills used by totems, traps, or mines. Cannot modify the skills of minions.

entries.name: Awakened Vicious Projectiles
entries.definition: Supports projectile attack skills.

entries.name: Awakened Void Manipulation
entries.definition: Supports any skill that deals damage.

entries.name: Ballista Totem
entries.definition: Supports any bow or wand attack skill, causing it to summon a ballista totem that uses the skill for you.

entries.name: Barrage Support
entries.definition: Supports projectile attack skills that use bows or wands. Cannot support triggered skills, channelled skills, or skills that create Minions.

entries.name: Behead
entries.definition: Supports strike skills.

entries.name: Blasphemy
entries.definition: Supports hex curse skills, turning them into auras that will apply their effect to all enemies in an area around you.

entries.name: Blastchain Mine
entries.definition: Supports spells, or attacks that use bows or wands. Instead of using that skill, you will throw a mine that will use the skill for you when you detonate it. Mines cannot use channelling skills.

entries.name: Blessed Call
entries.definition: Supports Warcries that are not triggered. Supported Warcries create Consecrated Ground, but have lowered area of effect and cooldown recovery.

entries.name: Blind
entries.definition: Supports any skill that hits enemies.

entries.name: Block Chance Reduction
entries.definition: Supports any skill that hits enemies.

entries.name: Bloodlust
entries.definition: Supports melee attack skills, causing them to deal more damage against bleeding enemies, but preventing those skills from inflicting bleeding on enemies in any way.

entries.name: Bloodsoaked Banner
entries.definition: Supports banner skills. Cannot modify the skills of minions.

entries.name: Bloodthirst
entries.definition: Supports attack skills. Cannot support triggered skills, skills which create minions, or skills used by totems, traps or mines.

entries.name: Bonechill
entries.definition: Supports any skill that can chill enemies or create chilling areas.

entries.name: Bonespire
entries.definition: Supports warcry skills you use yourself.

entries.name: Brutality
entries.definition: Supports any skill that deals damage.

entries.name: Burning Damage
entries.definition: Supports any skill that hits enemies, or can deal burning damage directly.

entries.name: Cast On Critical Strike
entries.definition: Must support both an attack skill and a spell skill to work. The attack skill will trigger a spell when it critically strikes an enemy. Cannot support totems, traps, or mines. Vaal skills, channelling skills, and skills with a reservation cannot be triggered.

entries.name: Cast on Death
entries.definition: Each supported spell skill will be triggered when you die. Cannot support skills used by totems, traps, or mines. Vaal skills, channelling skills, and skills with a reservation cannot be triggered.

entries.name: Cast on Ward Break
entries.definition: Each supported spell skill will be triggered when your Ward breaks. Cannot support skills used by totems, traps, or mines. Vaal skills, channelling skills, and skills with a reservation cannot be triggered.

entries.name: Cast when Damage Taken
entries.definition: Each supported spell skill will track damage you take, and be triggered when the total damage taken reaches a threshold. Cannot support skills used by totems, traps, or mines. Vaal skills, channelling skills, and skills with a reservation cannot be triggered.

entries.name: Cast when Stunned
entries.definition: Each supported spell skill will have a chance to be triggered when you are stunned. Cannot support skills used by totems, traps, or mines. Vaal skills, channelling skills, and skills with a reservation cannot be triggered.

entries.name: Cast while Channelling
entries.definition: Must support both a channelling skill and a non-channelling spell skill to work. The channelling skill will trigger a spell periodically while channelling. Cannot support skills used by totems, traps, or mines. Vaal skills and skills with a reservation cannot be triggered.

entries.name: Cast on Melee Kill
entries.definition: Must support both a melee attack skill and a spell skill to work. The attack skill will trigger a spell when it kills an enemy. Cannot support totems, traps, or mines. Vaal skills, channelling skills, and skills with a reservation cannot be triggered.

entries.name: Chain
entries.definition: Supports projectile skills, and any other skills that chain.

entries.name: Chance to Bleed
entries.definition: Supports attack skills.

entries.name: Chance to Flee
entries.definition: Supports any skill that hits enemies.

entries.name: Chance to Poison
entries.definition: Supports any skill that hits enemies.

entries.name: Charged Mines
entries.definition: Supports skills which throw mines.

entries.name: Charged Traps
entries.definition: Supports skills which throw traps.

entries.name: Close Combat
entries.definition: Supports melee attack skills. Cannot support skills which create minions.

entries.name: Cluster Traps
entries.definition: Supports traps skills, making them throw extra traps randomly around the targeted location.

entries.name: Cold Penetration
entries.definition: Supports any skill that hits enemies, making those hits penetrate enemy cold resistance.

entries.name: Cold to Fire
entries.definition: Supports any skill that hits enemies.

entries.name: Combustion
entries.definition: Supports any skill that hits enemies.

entries.name: Companionship
entries.definition: Supports skills that create minions which can be damaged. Cannot support triggered skills.

entries.name: Concentrated Effect
entries.definition: Supports any skill with an area of effect, regardless of whether that skill deals damage.

entries.name: Congregation
entries.definition: Supports skills which create Minions.

entries.name: Controlled Blaze
entries.definition: Supports melee attack skills.

entries.name: Controlled Destruction
entries.definition: Supports attack skills, or spell skills that deal damage.

entries.name: Cooldown Recovery
entries.definition: Supports skills that have a cooldown. Cannot modify the skills of minions.

entries.name: Corrupting Cry
entries.definition: Supports warcry skills. Cannot modify the skills of minions.

entries.name: Critical Strike Affliction
entries.definition: Supports any skill that hits enemies.

entries.name: Cruelty
entries.definition: Supports any skill that hits enemies. Minions cannot gain Cruelty.

entries.name: Coursing Current
entries.definition: Supports any skill that hits enemies.

entries.name: Crystalfall
entries.definition: Supports Slam skills. Cannot support triggered skills or skills used by things other than you.

entries.name: Cull the Weak
entries.definition: Supports any skill that hits enemies. If normal or magic enemies are left below a percentage of maximum life after being hit by these skills, they will be killed.

entries.name: Culling Strike
entries.definition: Supports any skill that hits enemies. If enemies are left below 10% of maximum life after being hit by these skills, they will be killed.

entries.name: Cursed Ground
entries.definition: Supports non-aura hex curse skills.

entries.definition: Supports aura skills that affect you and allies, increasing the aura's effect on allies, but preventing it from affecting you at all. Cannot support curse auras, or other auras that only affect enemies. Cannot support skills used by totems. Cannot modify the skills of minions.

If supporting a minion attack skill, the minion's skills will not also strike extra targets. Cannot support Vaal skills or triggered skills.

entries.name: Greater Volley
entries.definition: Supports skills that fire projectiles from the user. Does not affect projectiles fired from other locations as secondary effects. Does not support skills that fire projectiles in a spiral.

Must support both a skill that creates minions which can be damaged, and

entries.definition: Supports skills which throw Traps or Mines.

entries.name: Trauma
entries.definition: Supports melee strike skills that do not inherently apply Trauma. Cannot support triggered skills, Vaal skills, or skills used by things other than you. Cannot modify the skills of minions.

entries.name: Trinity
entries.definition: Supports skills that hit enemies, causing them to gain bonuses while you have resonance of all three elements, and to grant resonance of elements other than the highest one in a hit. There is a maximum of 50 Resonance for each Element. Cannot support triggered skills, instant skills, orb skills, brands, skills with a reservation, or skills used by totems, traps, or mines. Cannot modify the skills of minions.

entries.name: Unbound Ailments
entries.definition: Supports any skill that hits enemies or inflicts ailments

entries.name: Unholy Trinity
entries.definition: Supports skills that hit enemies, causing them to gain bonuses while you have unholy resonance of lightning, physical and chaos, and to grant unholy resonance of damage types other than the highest one in a hit. There is a maximum of 50 unholy resonance for each damage type. Cannot support triggered skills, instant skills, orb skills, brands, skills with a reservation, or skills used by totems, traps, or mines. Cannot modify the skills of minions.

entries.name: Unleash
entries.definition: Supports spell skills, making their effect reoccur when cast. Cannot support skills with cooldowns, triggered skills, Brand skills, Vaal skills, channelling skills, skills with a reservation, or skills used by totems, traps, or mines. Cannot modify the skills of minions.

entries.name: Urgent Orders
entries.definition: Supports warcry skills.

entries.name: Vaal Sacrifice
entries.definition: Supports Vaal spell skills, making them repeat when cast at the cost of your life and energy shield. Cannot support totem skills, channelling skills, triggered skills, instant skills, retaliation skills, blink skills, or skills with a reservation.

entries.name: Vaal Temptation
entries.definition: Supports Vaal skills.

entries.definition: Supports projectile attack skills.

entries.definition: Supports any skill that deals damage.

entries.name: Void Shockwave
entries.definition: Supports melee attack skills. Cannot support triggered attacks, attacks used by things other than you, or skills which create minions.

entries.name: Voidstorm
entries.definition: Supports ranged attack skills that fire projectiles upwards. Cannot support triggered attacks, attacks used by things other than you, or skills which create minions.

entries.name: Volatility
entries.definition: Supports attack skills.

entries.name: Volley
