entries.name: Windburst
entries.definition: Supports Attack Skills, causing them to trigger Windburst on hit after you've travelled a certain distance. Cannot support triggered skills or skills used by things other than you. Cannot modify the skills of minions.

entries.name: Withering Touch
entries.definition: Supports attack skills.

entries.name: Holy Sweep
entries.definition: Swings a two handed mace or a staff in a circle, calling down holy hammers to land randomly on a number of enemies struck. Hits from these holy hammers cannot be evaded.

entries.name: Holy Sweep of Hammerfalls
entries.definition: Swings a two handed mace or a staff in a circle, calling down waves of holy hammers for a duration. Cannot be supported by Multistrike.

entries.name: Swordstorm
entries.definition: Retaliate against a blocked hit with a hail of blades that rains down in front of you, repeatedly dealing the damage of both your weapons combined. Requires Dual Wielding Melee Weapons.

entries.name: Tectonic Slam
entries.definition: Slam the ground, unleashing a fiery fissure in front of you, dealing area damage and randomly releasing a number of smaller fissures branching off from it. Consume an Endurance Charge every third time you slam the ground with this skill. Requires a Mace, Sceptre, Sword, Axe, Staff, or Unarmed.

entries.name: Tectonic Slam of Cataclysm
entries.definition: Slam the ground, consuming all Endurance Charges and unleashing a fiery fissure in front of you, dealing area damage and randomly releasing a number of smaller fissures branching off from it. Requires a Mace, Sceptre, Sword, Axe, Staff, or Unarmed.

entries.name: Tempest Shield
entries.definition: Enchants your shield with the power of storms, which lashes out to deal arcing lightning damage to attackers when you block them.

entries.name: Temporal Chains
entries.definition: Curses all enemies in an area, lowering their action speed and making other effects on them expire more slowly.

entries.name: Temporal Rift
entries.definition: Reserves mana to apply a buff and leave afterimages of your recent past. Cast the spell again to return to the oldest afterimage, teleporting to that location as well as resetting your Life, Mana and Energy Shield to the values they had then.

entries.name: Thunderstorm
entries.definition: Fires an arrow into the air to land at a targeted location. On impact, deals area damage and creates a thunderstorm which blinds enemies within it. Entering the thunderstorm will cause it to gain stages, and leaving it will cause it to dissipate. Leaving the storm while it is at maximum stages will cause it to explode, dealing damage and triggering Thunderburst. You must use this skill yourself, it cannot be used by Totems, Traps, Mines, or other objects that use skills for you.

entries.name: Tornado
entries.definition: Create a Tornado that hinders and repeatedly damages enemies around it. It will move forward for a duration, during which your projectiles can collide with it to deal damage as though it was an enemy. Then it will chase down enemies for a secondary duration, and reflect a portion of the damage it took from your projectiles to them in addition to its own damage.

entries.name: Tornado of Elemental Turbulence
entries.definition: Create a Tornado of a random element that hinders and repeatedly damages enemies around it, converting physical damage to its element. The Tornado will chase down enemies for a duration.

entries.name: Tornado Shot
entries.definition: Fires a piercing shot that travels until it reaches the targeted location. It will then fire projectiles out in all directions from that point, which will travel for a short time before disappearing.

entries.name: Tornado Shot of Cloudburst
entries.definition: Fires a single payload arrow into the air to land at a targeted location. It will then fire arrows out in all directions from that point.

entries.name: Toxic Rain
entries.definition: Fire arrows into the air that rain down around the targeted area, dealing damage to enemies they hit and creating spore pods where they land. Each spore pod deals chaos damage over time to nearby enemies and slows their movement speed. The pods last for a duration before bursting, dealing area damage.

entries.name: Toxic Rain of Sporeburst
entries.definition: Fire arrows into the air that rain down around the targeted area, dealing damage to enemies they hit and creating spore pods where they land. Each spore pod slows the movement speed of nearby enemies. The pods last for a duration before bursting, dealing area damage.

entries.name: Toxic Rain of Withering
entries.definition: Fire arrows into the air that rain down around the targeted area, dealing damage to enemies they hit and creating spore pods where they land. Each spore pod deals chaos damage over time to nearby enemies and withers them, causing them to take increased chaos damage. The pods last for a duration before bursting, dealing area damage.

entries.name: Unearth
entries.definition: Fires a projectile that will pierce through enemies to impact the ground at the targeted location, creating a Bone Archer corpse where it lands.

entries.name: Vaal Absolution
entries.definition: Causes one of your existing Sentinels of Absolution to Ascend, becoming more powerful, gaining new spells, and overriding its duration, while maintaining its other bonuses, including from support gems. If you cannot have more Ascended Sentinels of Absolution, an existing one will be refreshed instead.

entries.name: Vaal Animate Weapon
entries.definition: Animates multiple Melee Weapon Items and Lingering Blades to fight by your side, and transforms them into different, unique weapons. You cannot animate unidentified Weapons. Will not animate weapons with 6 sockets. Cannot be used by Traps or Mines.

entries.name: Vaal Arc
entries.definition: A shocking arc of lightning reaches from the caster to a targeted enemy and chains to other enemies. Each time the arc chains from an enemy, it will do so simultaneously to two further enemies, but never to enemies that have already been hit by any of these chains. Also grants a buff making your Arc damage lucky for a short duration.

entries.name: Vaal Arctic Armour
entries.definition: Immediately encases you in ice, protecting you for a duration or until you take damage from a number of hits, and also grants a buff once the cast time has finished. You cannot move or perform non-instant actions while in the ice. When the ice breaks, the buff is also removed.

entries.name: Vaal Blade Flurry
entries.definition: Channel to create an expanding circle area around you that blinds enemies within it. When you stop channelling, deals damage in a smaller area around each enemy in the circle. Requires a Dagger, Claw or One-Handed Sword.

entries.name: Vaal Blade Vortex
entries.definition: Creates an independently-moving vortex of ethereal blades which lasts for a duration. The vortex moves toward nearby enemies, repeatedly damaging enemies that it passes through.

entries.name: Vaal Blight
entries.definition: Apply a powerful debuff to enemies around you which deals chaos damage over time. Then applies two additional layers in a larger area, growing greatly in size each time. Enemies are also substantially hindered for a shorter secondary duration, slowing their movement.

entries.name: Vaal Burning Arrow
entries.definition: Fires an arrow that explodes, dealing fire damage to its target and other nearby enemies, with an increased chance of igniting them.

entries.name: Vaal Caustic Arrow
entries.definition: Fires a slow-moving serpentine arrow which deals chaos damage while piercing enemies, and leaves a trail of caustic ground. Enemies standing on the caustic ground take chaos damage over time.

entries.name: Vaal Clarity
entries.definition: Casts a temporary aura that lets you and your allies cast skills without paying their mana costs.

entries.name: Vaal Cleave
entries.definition: The character swings their weapon (or both weapons if dual wielding) in an arc, damaging monsters in an area in front of them. Killing Blows on Rare or Unique enemies grant a buff that improves Cleave for a duration. Killing Blows on Rare Enemies also steal their modifiers for a secondary duration. Only works with Axes and Swords.

entries.name: Vaal Cold Snap
entries.definition: Creates a sudden burst of cold around you, damaging enemies. This also creates a chilling area around you which expands and deals cold damage over time to surrounding enemies in addition to chilling them. Enemies that die while in the area grant Frenzy Charges, and you will passively gain Frenzy Charges while there are enemies in the area.

entries.name: Vaal Cyclone
entries.definition: Spin and attack in place, damaging nearby enemies and pulling others towards you. While using this skill, you cannot be stunned or knocked back. Cannot be supported by Ruthless.

entries.name: Vaal Detonate Dead
entries.definition: Targets a corpse, and deals spell damage to enemies around the corpse, as well as causing the corpse to explode, dealing fire damage. The explosion is not affected by modifiers to spell damage and cannot be reflected. This will continue to target other corpses in the area, with an increasing delay between each one, until it runs out of corpses or has destroyed 22 corpses.

entries.name: Vaal Discipline
entries.definition: Casts a temporary aura that prevents energy shield recharge being delayed by damage taken for you and your allies.

entries.name: Vaal Domination
entries.definition: This spell causes one of your existing Sentinels of Dominance to Ascend, becoming more powerful, gaining new attacks, and overriding its duration, while maintaining its monster modifiers and other bonuses, including from support gems. If you cannot have more Ascended Sentinels of Dominance, an existing one will be refreshed instead.

entries.name: Vaal Double Strike
entries.definition: Performs two fast strikes with a melee weapon, each of which summons a double of you for a duration to continuously attack monsters in this fashion.

entries.name: Vaal Earthquake
entries.definition: Smashes the ground, dealing damage in an area and cracking the earth. The crack will erupt in a powerful aftershock after a short duration. After using this skill, your steps will deal damage around you, cracking the earth if the previous cracks have erupted. This effect ends after a secondary duration, or after a maximum number of aftershocks. Requires an Axe, Mace, Sceptre, Staff or Unarmed.

entries.name: Vaal Fireball
entries.definition: Launches a series of fireballs in a spiral around the caster.

entries.name: Vaal Firestorm
entries.definition: A fixed number of flaming bolts rain down in a spiral, culminating in the central one impacting the targeted location. They explode when landing, dealing damage to nearby enemies and leaving burning ground, which deals fire damage over time.

entries.name: Vaal Flameblast
entries.definition: Targets an area and builds up stages in that area based on cast speed. It explodes every 3 stages, until it reaches a maximum of 15. As it gains more stages, the area gets smaller but the damage gets higher.

entries.name: Vaal Flicker Strike
entries.definition: Repeatedly teleports to enemies and hits them, inflicting a wound but dealing no damage. After the repeating finishes, each enemy is hit by the total damage of their wounds, which are removed.

entries.name: Vaal Glacial Hammer
entries.definition: Hits enemies, converting some of your physical damage to cold damage. It traps enemies with you in a circle of ice so that they can't escape. Requires a Mace, Sceptre or Staff.

entries.name: Vaal Grace
entries.definition: Casts a temporary aura that grants you and your allies additional chance to evade attacks, and makes suppressed spell damage unlucky against you.

entries.name: Vaal Ground Slam
entries.definition: Slams the ground in front of you, creating a wave that travels in all directions that damages enemies with an increased chance to stun. The wave deals more damage to closer enemies. Requires an Axe, Mace, Sceptre, Staff or Unarmed.

entries.name: Vaal Haste
entries.definition: Casts a temporary aura that increases the movement speed, attack speed and cast speed of you and your allies.

entries.name: Vaal Ice Nova
entries.definition: A chilling circle of ice expands from the caster, repeating from every enemy it hits.

entries.name: Vaal Ice Shot
entries.definition: Fires an arrow that converts some physical damage to cold on its target and converts all physical damage to cold in a cone behind that target. When you use this skill, it summons a squad of Mirage Sharpshooters for a duration. Cannot be used by Totems, Traps, or Mines.

entries.name: Vaal Immortal Call
entries.definition: Discharges Endurance Charges, making the character unable to die or gain Vaal souls for a short time, proportional to how many endurance charges were expended.

entries.name: Vaal Impurity of Fire
entries.definition: Casts an aura that reduces fire damage taken and provides ignite immunity to you and nearby allies, and makes hits against nearby enemies ignore their fire resistance.

entries.name: Vaal Impurity of Ice
entries.definition: Casts an aura that reduces cold damage taken and provides freeze and chill immunity to you and nearby allies, and makes hits against nearby enemies ignore their cold resistance.

entries.name: Vaal Impurity of Lightning
entries.definition: Casts an aura that reduces lightning damage taken and provides shock immunity to you and nearby allies, and makes hits against nearby enemies ignore their lightning resistance.

entries.name: Vaal Lightning Arrow
entries.definition: Fires charged arrows, which repeatedly travel for a short time before changing direction. When they hit enemies, they are struck by a bolt of lightning which damages a number of surrounding enemies.

entries.name: Vaal Lightning Strike
entries.definition: Infuses your melee weapon with electrical energies as you swing. In addition to converting some of your physical damage to lightning damage, the stored energy becomes an orb attached to the enemy you hit, or the ground if you don't hit an enemy. The orb will periodically fire projectiles at other nearby enemies for a duration, which will also damage the enemy the orb is attached to.

entries.name: Vaal Lightning Trap
entries.definition: Throws a trap that launches a ring of projectiles through the enemy that set it off, dealing lightning damage to them and subsequent targets and leaving a trail of shocked ground.

entries.name: Vaal Lightning Warp
entries.definition: Casts a delayed teleport for nearby enemies to a target destination. When the teleport occurs, lightning damage is dealt to the enemies both before and after they teleport.

entries.name: Vaal Molten Shell
entries.definition: Applies a buff that raises your armour, and takes some of the damage from hits for you before being depleted. Each second, the skill deals reflected damage to surrounding enemies based on the damage taken by the buff in that second. When the buff is removed, the skill deals reflected damage to enemies around you based on the total damage that was taken by the buff. You cannot have the buff at the same time as any other Guard skill.

entries.name: Vaal Molten Strike
entries.definition: Infuses your melee weapon with molten energies to attack with physical and fire damage. This attack causes balls of molten magma to launch forth causing area attack damage to enemies where they land.

entries.name: Vaal Breach
entries.definition: This skill is temporarily disabled and cannot be used.

entries.name: Vaal Power Siphon
entries.definition: Fires your wand simultaneously at all nearby enemies, culling those close to death and granting you a power charge for each. Cannot be supported by Volley.

entries.name: Vaal Rain of Arrows
entries.definition: Fires multiple arrows into the air, to land in multiple sequences after a delay, each starting at the targeted location and spreading outwards in all directions. Each arrow deals damage in an area around it. Half of the arrows will land directly on targets if there are targets in their range.

entries.name: Vaal Reap
entries.definition: Bloody scythes swipe around a selected area, hitting enemies with physical damage. An area of boiling blood is left beneath them for a duration which deals physical damage over time. Also gives a bonus to maximum Blood Charges for a secondary duration.

entries.name: Vaal Reave
entries.definition: Repeatedly attacks a large area in different directions. Each Vaal Reave that hits an enemy grants stages, which you will begin to lose after a short period without hitting anything. Only works with Daggers, Claws, and One-Handed Swords.

entries.name: Vaal Rejuvenation Totem
entries.definition: Summons a totem that has an aura which regenerates life for you and your nearby allies. When things affected by the aura are hit, the totem's life is removed instead for some of the damage.

entries.name: Vaal Righteous Fire
entries.definition: Sacrifices a portion of your Life and Energy Shield to engulf you in magical fire that rapidly burns nearby enemies for a duration. Your spell damage is increased while under this effect.

entries.name: Vaal Smite
entries.definition: Calls lightning down to infuse your weapon, then performs a melee attack and causes lightning to strike nearby enemies, dealing damage in an area. Hitting an enemy grants an aura for a duration. Requires a Sword, Axe, Mace, Sceptre, Staff or Unarmed.

entries.name: Vaal Spark
entries.definition: Continuously launches unpredictable sparks in all directions that move randomly until they hit an enemy or expire.

entries.name: Vaal Spectral Throw
entries.definition: Throws several spectral copies of your melee weapon. They fly out and then return to you, in a spinning attack that damages enemies in their path.

entries.name: Vaal Storm Call
entries.definition: Sets a marker at a location. Lightning strikes random enemies around the marker repeatedly over the skill's duration, dealing damage in an area around the strike. Modifiers to the skill's duration will also affect the delay between these strikes. When the duration ends, a large bolt of lightning strikes the marker, dealing damage around it.

entries.name: Vaal Summon Skeletons
entries.definition: Summons an army of skeletal soldiers, archers and mages, led by a powerful general.

entries.name: Vaal Venom Gyre
entries.definition: Creates already-caught projectiles without firing them first, both immediately and over a secondary duration. Caught projectiles spiral outwards when you use Whirling Blades and do not return. Requires a Dagger or Claw.

entries.name: Vaal Volcanic Fissure
entries.definition: Slam the ground, creating a winding fissure that deals area damage while travelling outwards. When it reaches the target location it erupts, releasing a burst of molten projectiles. After erupting, the fissure continues moving towards enemies to cause further eruptions. Requires an Axe, Mace, Sceptre, Staff or Unarmed.

entries.name: Vampiric Link
entries.definition: Targets an allied player to apply a buff which links you to them for a duration. While linked, they get recovery from your life leech instead of you. If the target dies while linked, you will also die. This skill cannot be triggered, or used by Totems, Traps, or Mines.

entries.name: Vengeful Cry
entries.definition: Retaliate against a savage hit with a warcry, taunting all nearby enemies to attack the user. The user and nearby allies gain a buff which grants rage and prevents rage from being lost. Minions cannot gain rage.

entries.name: Venom Gyre
entries.definition: Fires a returning projectile that can be caught. Caught projectiles spiral outwards when you use Whirling Blades and do not return. Requires a Dagger or Claw.

entries.name: Vigilant Strike
entries.definition: Attacks enemies with a powerful melee strike which grants Fortification, reducing damage you take from hits. The cooldown can be bypassed by expending an Endurance Charge. Requires a Melee Weapon.

entries.name: Viper Strike
entries.definition: Hits enemies, converting some of your physical damage to chaos damage and inflicting poison which will be affected by modifiers to skill duration. If dual wielding, will strike with both weapons. Requires a claw, dagger or sword.

entries.name: Viper Strike of the Mamba
entries.definition: Hits enemies, converting some of your physical damage to chaos damage and inflicting poison which will be affected by modifiers to skill duration. If dual wielding, deals the damage of both weapons in one strike. Requires a claw, dagger or sword.

entries.name: Vitality
entries.definition: Casts an aura that grants life regeneration to you and your allies.

entries.name: Void Sphere
entries.definition: Creates a Void Sphere which Hinders enemies in an area around it, with the debuff being stronger on enemies closer to the sphere. It also regularly releases pulses of area damage. The Void Sphere will consume the corpses of any enemies which die in its area. Can only have one Void Sphere at a time.

entries.name: Void Sphere of Rending
entries.definition: Creates a Void Sphere which Hinders enemies in an area around it, with the debuff being stronger on enemies closer to the sphere. It also regularly releases pulses of area damage. The Void Sphere will consume the corpses of any enemies which die in its area. Can only have one Void Sphere at a time.

entries.name: Volatile Dead
entries.definition: Corpses near the targeted location explode, dealing damage in a small area and creating an orb which moves towards nearby enemies before dealing spell damage in a larger area. The explosion of the corpse is not affected by modifiers to spell damage, and cannot be reflected.

entries.name: Volatile Dead of Confinement
entries.definition: Corpses near the targeted location explode, dealing damage in a small area and creating an orb which detonates after a duration, dealing spell damage in a larger area. The explosion of the corpse is not affected by modifiers to spell damage, and cannot be reflected.

entries.name: Volatile Dead of Seething
entries.definition: Corpses near the targeted location explode, dealing damage in a small area and creating an orb which moves towards nearby enemies before dealing spell damage in a larger area. The explosion of the corpse is not affected by modifiers to spell damage, and cannot be reflected.

entries.name: Volcanic Fissure
entries.definition: Slam the ground, creating a winding fissure that deals area damage while travelling outwards. When it reaches the target location it erupts, releasing a burst of molten projectiles. Requires an Axe, Mace, Sceptre, Staff or Unarmed.

entries.name: Volcanic Fissure of Snaking
entries.definition: Slam the ground, creating a winding fissure that deals area damage while travelling outwards. When it reaches the target location it erupts dealing damage in an area. After erupting, the fissure continues moving towards enemies to cause further eruptions. Requires an Axe, Mace, Sceptre, Staff or Unarmed.

entries.name: Voltaxic Burst
entries.definition: Each cast of this spell waits for a short duration, releasing a burst of lightning and chaos spell damage in an area around you when that duration ends. Enemies killed by this damage, or shortly after, will explode. The explosions of the corpses are not affected by modifiers to spell damage, and cannot be reflected.

entries.name: Vortex
entries.definition: An icy blast explodes around the caster, dealing cold damage to enemies, and leaving behind a whirling vortex which deals cold damage over time and chills enemies caught in it.

entries.name: Vortex of Projection
entries.definition: An icy blast explodes around the caster, dealing cold damage to enemies, and leaving behind a whirling vortex which deals cold damage over time and chills enemies caught in it. If the caster targets near their Frostbolt projectiles, it will explode from a number of those projectiles instead, destroying them.

entries.name: Vulnerability
entries.definition: Curse all targets in an area, causing them to take increased physical damage. Attacks against the cursed enemies have a chance to inflict bleeding.

entries.name: Wall of Force
entries.definition: Creates a wall of force which allies and enemies can pass through, but allied projectiles which can collide with enemies will also collide with this wall, and can chain from it to other targets. Projectiles can only collide with a single Wall of Force, and no more than once.

entries.name: War Banner
entries.definition: You must gain Valour from melee combat to use this skill, which will consume all Valour to place a banner with an aura. The aura will be larger and more powerful the more Valour was consumed. The banner lasts for a duration, but will end early if you leave the aura, or use the skill again while it's active.

entries.name: Warlord's Mark
entries.definition: Curses a single enemy, giving a chance to double the duration of stuns on them. Attacking the cursed enemy will leech life and mana, stunning them will grant rage, and killing it will grant an endurance charge. You can only have one Mark at a time.

entries.name: Wave of Conviction
entries.definition: An expanding wave of energy surges forward, damaging enemies in a cone-shaped area over a duration. Each enemy hit is inflicted with Exposure matching the element of which they took the highest damage. Only one Wave of Conviction can be active at a time

entries.name: Wave of Conviction of Trarthus
entries.definition: An expanding wave of energy surges outwards from you, damaging enemies in a ring-shaped area over a duration. The ring then returns, damaging enemies again on the way back. Only one Wave of Conviction can be active at a time

entries.name: Whirling Blades
entries.definition: Dive through enemies, dealing weapon damage. If dual wielding attacks with both weapons, dealing the damage of both in one hit. Only works with Daggers, Claws, and One-Handed Swords.

entries.name: Wild Strike
entries.definition: Your melee weapon strikes enemies, converting physical damage to a random element. Then, depending on the element chosen, it releases a fiery explosion, an arcing bolt of lightning, or an icy wave. It will avoid choosing the same element twice in a row.

entries.name: Wild Strike of Extremes
entries.definition: Your melee weapon strikes enemies, converting physical damage to a random element. Then, depending on the element chosen, it releases a fiery explosion, an arcing bolt of lightning, or an icy wave. It will avoid choosing the same element twice in a row.

entries.name: Winter Orb
entries.definition: Channel to conjure an orb above you, which pelts nearby enemies with projectiles that impact the ground and explode. Channelling for longer builds up stages on the skill. When you stop channelling, the stages decay over a duration.

entries.name: Wintertide Brand
entries.definition: Creates a magical brand which can attach to a nearby enemy, dealing cold damage over time and chilling them. It periodically activates while attached, gaining stages that raise the damage. When removed, a short-duration debuff dealing the same damage over time and chill is applied to each nearby enemy. The brand keeps its charges while detached.

entries.name: Wither
entries.definition: Casts a debilitating debuff on enemies in an area, hindering their movement and also inflicts the Withered debuff, which increases the Chaos Damage they take and can stack up to 15 times.

entries.name: Withering Step
entries.definition: Grants Elusive and a buff that grants Phasing. While you have this buff, monsters that enter an area around you will be Withered. Using a skill or losing the Elusive buff ends this skill's effects. Shares a cooldown with other Blink skills. Cannot be used while already Elusive.

entries.name: Wrath
entries.definition: Casts an aura that adds lightning damage to the attacks of you and your allies, and makes your spells deal more lightning damage.

entries.name: Zealotry
entries.definition: Casts an aura that grants bonuses to damage and critical strike chance of spells to you and your allies, and gives a chance to create Consecrated Ground against stronger enemies.

entries.name: Affliction
entries.definition: Permanently Afflicts any of your damageable minions in a targeted area, causing them to take physical damage over time, at an accelerating rate. Each such minion causes you to regenerate life at a rate based on the current damage of it's Affliction debuff. Afflicted Minions explode if their life is lowered to a fifth of maximum.

entries.name: Unbound Avatar
entries.definition: Gain Unbound Fury by inflicting Elemental Ailments with Hits on enemies. Once you reach maximum Unbound Fury, consume it to become Unbound, vastly augmenting your Elemental prowess.

entries.name: Animate Guardian's Weapon
entries.definition: Animates a copy of your Animated Guardian's main-hand weapon to fight by your side.

entries.name: Tears of Rot
entries.definition: While active, this skill inflicts the Weeping Black debuff on impaled enemies you hit with bow attacks. Weeping Black deals physical damage over time, and can stack up to five times. This skill cannot be cast by Totems.

entries.name: Approaching Flames
entries.definition: Become touched by the flames of the Cleansing Fire.

entries.name: Aspect of Arakaali
entries.definition: While active, you inflict Wither on hit, and Wither you inflict will be reflected back to you. Additionally, for each stack of Wither on you, your Life recovery rate is increased.

entries.name: Aspect of Lunaris
entries.definition: While active, taking Physical or Elemental Damage will grant you either Lunar Protection or Lunar Resistance, respectively. Aspect of Lunaris lessens incoming Physical Damage for each Lunar Protection on you, and lessens incoming Elemental Damage for each Lunar Resistance on you. These buffs can both stack up to eight times.

entries.name: Aspect of Solaris
entries.definition: While active, inflicts Fire Exposure on enemies within its radius. Additionally, periodically applies a Sunscald debuff to enemies within its radius, with each Sunscald debuff increasing the effect of exposure on affected enemies. Sunscald can stack up to five times.

entries.name: Aspect of the Avian
entries.definition: While active, grants the Avian's Might and Avian's Flight buffs in sequence. Avian's Might grants you and your minions a chance to deal Double Damage with hits for a duration. Avian's Flight grants you and your minions increased Movement Speed for a secondary duration.

entries.name: Aspect of the Brine King
entries.definition: While active, inflicts Chill on enemies within it's radius, while also increasing the strength of Chill you inflict and causing Damage you deal to Chilled enemies to penetrate some of their Cold Resistance.

entries.name: Aspect of the Cat
entries.definition: While active, grants the Cat's Stealth and Cat's Agility buffs in sequence. Cat's Stealth increases your critical strike chance, makes you harder to see, and gives you a chance to avoid damage for a short duration. Cat's Agility increases your attack and cast speed for a longer secondary duration.

entries.name: Aspect of the Crab
entries.definition: While active, periodically adds Crab Barriers to you, and grants additional Physical Damage reduction for each Crab Barrier you have. All Crab Barriers are lost when you take physical damage from a hit.

entries.name: Aspect of the Spider
entries.definition: While active, periodically applies a Spider's Web debuff to nearby Enemies, and Hinders them. Each Spider's Web on an Enemy increases the Damage they take. Hinder reduces their movement speed.

entries.name: Flames of Judgement
entries.definition: Creates markers at your location and a targeted location, which grow over time based on cast speed, then explode, dealing fire damage. Cannot be supported by Spell Cascade.

entries.name: Storm of Judgement
entries.definition: Creates a number of markers around the targeted location, which will explode after a duration, dealing lightning damage. Cannot be supported by Spell Cascade.

entries.name: Barkskin
entries.definition: Adopt the power of the forest, gradually covering your body in bark. Getting hit by enemy attacks causes bark to be removed. You take reduced damage from physical attack hits the more bark builds up, but higher chance to evade when less covered in bark.

entries.name: Savage Barnacle
entries.definition: Creates a giant barnacle that continually snaps at enemies, dealing off-hand area damage augmented by the defences of the shield. Increases and reductions to attack speed affect the rate at which damage occurs.

entries.name: Caustic Retribution
entries.definition: When hit, release a nova of venomous bile that deals spell chaos damage. This nova poisons and hinders on hit.

entries.name: Blood Offering
entries.definition: Consumes a corpse, and sacrifices a portion of your life, granting your minions life regeneration based on the life sacrificed, and a bonus to damage. The skill consumes other nearby corpses, increasing the duration and life regeneration for each corpse consumed.

entries.name: Blood Sacrament
entries.definition: Channel this skill to reserve more and more of your life, building up power in a marker on the ground under you. Release to deal physical damage in an area based on how much life you reserved. Cannot be cast by Totems.

entries.name: Explosive Toad
entries.definition: A toad spawns from the corpse of the slain enemy, leaps towards enemies and explodes, dealing forty percent of the slain enemy's Life as Chaos Damage. This skill's damage is not affected by modifiers to spell damage and cannot be reflected.

entries.name: Bone Armour
entries.definition: Applies a buff to you and each of your minions, which will take some of the damage from enemy hits before being depleted. The buff also grants immunity to bleeding. Shares a cooldown with other Guard skills.

entries.name: Bone Nova
entries.definition: Bones erupt around enemies you hit, dealing physical damage.

entries.name: Brandsurge
entries.definition: Overcharges your brands near the targeted area, causing them to accelerate how quickly they activate and expire. Deals damage in an area around each overcharged brand when it expires.

entries.name: Will of the Lords
entries.definition: Throws out a trap which creates a rift, attracting a malefic hand from another realm. When the trap is triggered, the hand tears the bottom of the breach out, shattering reality to deal spell damage in an area.

entries.name: Intimidating Cry
entries.definition: Performs a warcry, taunting nearby enemies to attack the user and exerting subsequent attacks. The user and nearby allies gain a buff that grants movement speed.

entries.name: Ceaseless Flesh
entries.definition: Once per second, raise a nearby corpse as a shambling undead. This minion will follow you and attack your enemies with melee strikes, but quickly falls apart. These minions have significantly increased attack speed while on low life.

entries.name: Cold Aegis
entries.definition: Calls forth a protective aegis which takes cold damage from hits for you until depleted. The aegis will be restored to its full value after a short delay if you stop taking cold damage from hits, or if depleted.

entries.name: Convocation
entries.definition: Recalls all minions that are following you to your location, and grants them a temporary life regeneration effect.

entries.name: Corpse Walk
entries.definition: Spawns corpses around you while you move, based on monsters in the current area. If you are using the Raise Spectre skill there is a chance to spawn spectral corpses matching your most recently raised Spectres. Spectral corpses cannot be interacted with except by Minion skills.

entries.name: Contaminate
entries.definition: Creates a patch of Fungal Ground at the targeted location.

entries.name: Death Aura
entries.definition: Casts an aura that deals Chaos Damage over Time to nearby Enemies. This skill cannot be cast by Totems.

entries.name: Death Walk
entries.definition: While you walk, this skill causes corpses near your steps to explode, dealing fire damage in an area. The explosions of the corpses are not affected by modifiers to spell damage, and cannot be reflected.

entries.name: Death Wish
entries.definition: As you channel this spell, it spreads its effect to more of your minions. When you stop channelling, each affected minion explodes, and this skill deals spell damage around them.  The explosion of the minion is not affected by modifiers to spell damage, and cannot be reflected.

entries.name: Doryani's Touch
entries.definition: The character uses their fist to slam the ground in front of them, with less attack speed, but more damage. This attack deals Lightning Damage to enemies in a large area, with a chance to Shock them. Cannot be used while wielding a Weapon. Cannot be Evaded.

entries.name: Elemental Aegis
entries.definition: Calls forth a protective aegis which takes elemental damage from hits for you until depleted. The aegis will be restored to its full value after a short delay if you stop taking elemental damage from hits, or if depleted.

entries.name: Elemental Warding
entries.definition: Fires projectiles in all directions, converting all their physical damage to a random element, and grants a buff which makes you unaffected by curses for a duration. Removes curses on you when used.

entries.name: Embrace Madness
entries.definition: Grants Glorious Madness. Using this skill again will remove Glorious Madness and the Touched Debuffs it inflicts, but you will be unable to Embrace Madness again until the cooldown expires.

entries.name: Word of Blades
entries.definition: Fires a chaining burst of ethereal blades.

entries.name: Edict of Blades
entries.definition: Fires a chaining burst of ethereal blades.

entries.name: Decree of Blades
entries.definition: Fires a chaining burst of ethereal blades.

entries.name: Commandment of Blades
entries.definition: Fires a chaining burst of ethereal blades.

entries.name: Word of Flames
entries.definition: Releases a nova of fire around you, damaging nearby enemies.

entries.name: Edict of Flames
entries.definition: Releases a nova of fire around you, damaging nearby enemies.

entries.name: Decree of Flames
entries.definition: Releases a nova of fire around you, damaging nearby enemies.

entries.name: Commandment of Flames
entries.definition: Releases a nova of fire around you, damaging nearby enemies.

entries.name: Word of Force
entries.definition: Release an arc of force from your weapon or fists, damaging enemies in front of you.

entries.name: Edict of Force
entries.definition: Release an arc of force from your weapon or fists, damaging enemies in front of you.

entries.name: Decree of Force
entries.definition: Release an arc of force from your weapon or fists, damaging enemies in front of you.

entries.name: Commandment of Force
entries.definition: Release an arc of force from your weapon or fists, damaging enemies in front of you.

entries.name: Word of Frost
entries.definition: Fire icy projectiles around you in all directions.

entries.name: Edict of Frost
entries.definition: Fire icy projectiles around you in all directions.

entries.name: Decree of Frost
entries.definition: Fire icy projectiles around you in all directions.

entries.name: Commandment of Frost
entries.definition: Fire icy projectiles around you in all directions.

entries.name: Word of Fury
entries.definition: Repeatedly fires a piercing projectile based on your weapon, converting some physical damage to fire. The projectiles form an arc in front of you.

entries.name: Edict of Fury
entries.definition: Repeatedly fires a piercing projectile based on your weapon, converting some physical damage to fire. The projectiles form an arc in front of you.

entries.name: Decree of Fury
entries.definition: Repeatedly fires a piercing projectile based on your weapon, converting some physical damage to fire. The projectiles form an arc in front of you.

entries.name: Commandment of Fury
entries.definition: Repeatedly fires a piercing projectile based on your weapon, converting some physical damage to fire. The projectiles form an arc in front of you.

entries.name: Word of Inferno
entries.definition: Drops a meteor from above on a nearby foe, dealing fire damage in an area around them.

entries.name: Edict of Inferno
entries.definition: Drops a meteor from above on a nearby foe, dealing fire damage in an area around them.

entries.name: Decree of Inferno
entries.definition: Drops a meteor from above on a nearby foe, dealing fire damage in an area around them.

entries.name: Commandment of Inferno
entries.definition: Drops a meteor from above on a nearby foe, dealing fire damage in an area around them.

entries.name: Word of Ire
entries.definition: Release a lightning charged spinning copy of your weapon or its projectiles that rotates around a point, damaging enemies in an area.

entries.name: Edict of Ire
entries.definition: Release a lightning charged spinning copy of your weapon or its projectiles that rotates around a point, damaging enemies in an area.

entries.name: Decree of Ire
entries.definition: Release a lightning charged spinning copy of your weapon or its projectiles that rotates around a point, damaging enemies in an area.

entries.definition: Release a lightning charged spinning copy of your weapon or its projectiles that rotates around a point, damaging enemies in an area.

entries.name: Word of Light
entries.definition: Deals a portion of your main hand damage in an area around you and creates Consecrated Ground, causing you and your allies to regenerate life.

entries.name: Edict of Light
entries.definition: Deals a portion of your main hand damage in an area around you and creates Consecrated Ground, causing you and your allies to regenerate life.

entries.name: Decree of Light
entries.definition: Deals a portion of your main hand damage in an area around you and creates Consecrated Ground, causing you and your allies to regenerate life.

entries.name: Commandment of Light
entries.definition: Deals a portion of your main hand damage in an area around you and creates Consecrated Ground, causing you and your allies to regenerate life.

entries.name: Word of Reflection
entries.definition: Creates a clone of you that attacks with your weapon.

entries.name: Edict of Reflection
entries.definition: Creates a clone of you that attacks with your weapon.

entries.name: Decree of Reflection
entries.definition: Creates a clone of you that attacks with your weapon.

entries.name: Commandment of Reflection
entries.definition: Creates a clone of you that attacks with your weapon.

entries.definition: Releases a circle of projectiles based on your weapon, leaving chilled ground in their wake.

entries.name: Envy
entries.definition: Casts an aura that adds chaos damage to the attacks and spells of you and your allies.

entries.name: Fiery Impact
entries.definition: Deals attack damage in an area.

entries.name: Fire Aegis
entries.definition: Calls forth a protective aegis which takes fire damage from hits for you until depleted. The aegis will be restored to its full value after a short delay if you stop taking fire damage from hits, or if depleted.

entries.name: Fire Burst
entries.definition: A burst of flame errupts from the location of a hit, dealing fire damage.

entries.name: Focus
entries.definition: Focus your power, granting yourself the Focused buff.

entries.name: Fog of War
entries.definition: Creates a Smoke Cloud in an area, which blinds enemies within it.

entries.name: Detonate Mines
entries.definition: Detonates a Mine, starting a Detonation Sequence which will detonate other Mines around it.

entries.name: Ghostly Artillery
entries.definition: Manifest a row of Ghostly Cannons, each of which then fires after a short delay dealing the damage of the weapon that triggered it. For each additional projectile this skill would fire, create an additional Ghostly Cannon instead.

entries.name: Gluttony of Elements
entries.definition: Casts an aura that causes taking elemental damage to heal you and nearby allies instead.

entries.name: Gore Shockwave
entries.definition: Deals attack damage in an area.

entries.name: Herald of the Hive
entries.definition: Grants a buff which causes you to deal more damage for each Herald skill affecting you. While you have this buff, this skill turns the space around you into a tear in reality, releasing pulses that damage enemies around you. Inflicting Ailments causes you to gain Otherworldly Pressure, which increases the frequency of the pulses. You will lose Otherworldly Pressure over time, at a rate which increases the more of it you have. The damage inflicted by this skill is not affected by modifiers to spell damage.

entries.name: Icestorm
entries.definition: Icy bolts rain down over the targeted area. They explode when landing, dealing damage to nearby enemies and chilling them, as well as causing patches of chilled ground. Skill damage is based on Intelligence.

entries.name: Icicle Burst
entries.definition: This attack fires icy projectiles in a circle around enemies you hit, dealing attack damage with all physical damage converted to cold.

entries.name: Illusory Warp
entries.definition: Teleport to a target destination. Chilled ground is spread in an area around both where the caster was and where they teleported to.

entries.name: Lightning Aegis
entries.definition: Calls forth a protective aegis which takes lightning damage from hits for you until depleted. The aegis will be restored to its full value after a short delay if you stop taking lightning damage from hits, or if depleted.

entries.name: Lightning Bolt
entries.definition: A bolt of lightning strikes an area, dealing lightning damage.

entries.name: Manifest Dancing Dervishes
entries.definition: Manifests two Dancing Dervishes to fight by your side. While a Dancing Dervish is manifested, you have Onslaught and cannot use Weapons. Cannot be supported by supports that would create other minions.

entries.name: Default Attack
entries.definition: Strike your foes down with a powerful blow.

entries.name: Default Attack
entries.definition: Strike your foes down with a powerful blow.

entries.name: Misty Reflection
entries.definition: Dash backwards, leaving a short-lived mist copy of yourself that Taunts nearby Enemies for a short duration. The copy can be damaged by Enemies, and copies that are killed by an Enemy will apply a debuff in an area that makes affected targets take 30% increased Damage and deal 30% less Damage for 4 seconds.

entries.name: Pacify
entries.definition: Curses all targets in an area, having no effect at first, but causing them to deal no damage once 60% of the curse's duration has expired.

entries.name: Pact of Beidat
entries.definition: Cast a pact, Empowering non-channelling spells that either fire projectiles, apply an effect to an area around a targeted location or fire chaining beams, causing them to deal more damage and have enhanced coverage. However, using this skill also burdens you with an Affliction.

entries.name: Pact of Ghorr
entries.definition: Cast a pact, Empowering your damage over time spells but burdening you with an Affliction. This skill also grants the Hunger of Ghorr buff for a duration causing Fleshrend to trigger periodically.

entries.name: Pact of K'Tash
entries.definition: Cast a pact, Empowering your damaging Vaal spells but burdening you with an Affliction. Empowered Vaal spells deal more damage, have less soul gain prevention duration and regain consumed souls on use.

entries.name: Pact of Lycia
entries.definition: Cast a pact, Empowering the next channelling spells you cast yourself but burdening you with an Affliction. Empowered spells deal more damage and periodically trigger lightning bolts while channelling.

entries.name: Penance Mark
entries.definition: Curses a single enemy, causing them to spawn multiple phantasms when hit. The phantasms will be allies of the marked enemy with the same monster level. They cast a projectile spell which deals physical damage, and are immune to curses and knockback. You can only have one Mark at a time.

entries.name: Physical Aegis
entries.definition: Calls forth a protective aegis which takes physical damage from hits for you until depleted. The aegis will be restored to its full value after a short delay if you stop taking physical damage from hits, or if depleted.

entries.name: Portal
entries.definition: Creates a portal to the current area's town.

entries.name: Primal Aegis
entries.definition: Calls forth a protective aegis which takes elemental damage from hits for you until depleted. The aegis will be restored to its full value after a short delay if you stop taking elemental damage from hits, or if depleted.

entries.name: Queen's Demand
entries.definition: Alternates triggering Flames of Judgement and Storm of Judgement

entries.name: Raise Spiders
entries.definition: Raise two spectral spiders from each nearby corpse that will attack your enemies with Viper Strike. Each raised spider grants you increased Attack Speed and increased Damage with Poison. Enemies will not engage the spiders directly, and they are immune to damage.

entries.name: Ravenous
entries.definition: Consumes a targeted corpse, granting you a buff that gives you bonuses against enemies of the same monster category as the corpse.

entries.name: Abberath's Fury
entries.definition: While you run, this skill creates a small explosion with each step, dealing fire damage in an area around you.

entries.name: Cinders
entries.definition: While active, your bow attacks inflict Cinderflame. Cinderflame deals fire damage over time, and can stack up to ten times. This skill cannot be cast by Totems.

entries.name: Shade Form
entries.definition: Makes you immune to physical damage, and harder for enemies to detect, for a duration.

entries.name: Shaper's Ire
entries.definition: Shaper's Memory casts this spell for you to fire a damaging beam for a duration that deals damage over time to things in it.

entries.name: Shaper's Despair
entries.definition: Shaper's Memory casts this spell for you to fire piercing projectiles in front of you that deal cold damage.

entries.name: Shaper's Devastation
entries.definition: Shaper's Memory uses this attack for you to teleport to an enemy and attack with a powerful blow, dealing area damage based on your weapon.

entries.name: Shield Shatter
entries.definition: Your shield shatters, dealing physical spell damage to enemies in an area, based on the shield's quality. For a short duration after this, you will be unable to block and will gain no defences from your shield, but your spells will deal added physical damage.

entries.name: Blazing Glare
entries.definition: When hit, release a nova of fiery vengeance, dealing spell fire damage and blinding enemies struck.

entries.name: Spectral Spirits
entries.definition: Summons three invulnerable spectral skulls that rush at nearby enemies and attack them rapidly. Enemies will not engage these spirits, and can pass through them.

entries.name: Spirit Burst
entries.definition: Consumes a spirit charge to fire projectiles which deals physical damage.

entries.name: Stalking Pustule
entries.definition: A corpse near the targeted location explodes, dealing damage in a small area and creating an orb which moves towards nearby enemies before dealing spell damage in a larger area. The explosion of the corpse is not affected by modifiers to spell damage, and cannot be reflected.

entries.name: Storm Cascade
entries.definition: Lightning crackles in a series of small bursts, each damaging enemies caught in the area.

entries.name: Summon Bone Feeders
entries.definition: Summon two Bone Feeders which follow you around. Bone Feeders consume corpses they walk over, creating a temporary Aura after consuming 10 corpses. One Bone Feeder creates a Curse Aura of either Temporal Chains, Enfeeble or Punishment that ignores Curse Limits. The other Bone Feeder creates an Aura that causes Enemy Damage with Hits to be Unlucky.

entries.name: Summon Arbalists
entries.definition: Summons Arbalist minions which use projectile attacks.

entries.name: Summon Bestial Rhoa
entries.definition: Summons a Bestial Rhoa. In addition to its melee attack, the Bestial Rhoa uses a charge and has an aura that intimidates enemies. Enemies will not engage this minion directly, and they are immune to damage.

entries.name: Summon Bestial Snake
entries.definition: Summons a Bestial Snake. The Bestial Snake fires powerful chaos projectile attacks. Enemies will not engage this minion directly, and they are immune to damage.

entries.name: Summon Bestial Ursa
entries.definition: Summons a Bestial Ursa. In addition to its melee attack, the Bestial Ursa uses a powerful Ground Slam and Rallying Cry. Enemies will not engage this minion directly, and they are immune to damage.

entries.name: Summon Doedre's Effigy
entries.definition: Summons an effigy of Doedre, which will project auras of all the curse skill gems socketed in Doedre's Skin. These curses have less effectiveness.

entries.name: Summon Elemental Relic
entries.definition: Summons a Relic of a random element that stays near you. Depending on the element chosen, the relic minion will have an Anger, Hatred, or Wrath aura. These relics explode when they die, dealing elemental damage to enemies around them. If you already have a relic of the chosen element, its duration will be refreshed instead of summoning a new one.

entries.name: Summon Harbinger of Brutality
entries.definition: Summons an immortal Harbinger minion. When you are near a rare or unique enemy, the minion will occasionally grant you a buff giving significantly increased Damage, Attack Speed, and Movement Speed, and reducing the Damage you take.

entries.name: Summon Greater Harbinger of Brutality
entries.definition: Summons an immortal Harbinger minion. When you are near a rare or unique enemy, the minion will occasionally grant you a buff giving significantly increased Damage, Attack Speed, and Movement Speed, reducing the Damage you take, and causing Bleeding Enemies that you Kill to Explode, dealing 10% of their maximum Life as Physical Damage.

entries.name: Summon Harbinger of Directions
entries.definition: Summons an immortal Harbinger minion. The minion will cast a random buff on you that grants one or all of the following: 1 additional Projectile, +1 Chain, Pierce 1 additional Target, or Projectiles Fork.

entries.name: Summon Greater Harbinger of Directions
entries.definition: Summons an immortal Harbinger minion. The minion will cast a random buff on you that grants one or all of the following: Fire 2 additional Projectiles, Chain 2 additional times, Projectiles Pierce 2 additional targets, or Projectiles Fork then Fork an additional time.

entries.name: Summon Harbinger of Focus
entries.definition: Summons an immortal Harbinger minion. While you are channelling, the minion will occasionally cast a buff on you that reduces the Damage you take, and makes you avoid all Stuns and Elemental Ailments.

entries.name: Summon Visiting Harbinger of Focus
entries.definition: Summons an immortal Harbinger minion. While you are channelling, the minion will occasionally cast a buff on you that reduces the Damage you take, makes you avoid all Stuns and Elemental Ailments, and prevents Curses affecting you.

entries.name: Summon Greater Harbinger of Focus
entries.definition: Summons an immortal Harbinger minion. While you are channelling, the minion will occasionally cast a buff on you that reduces the Damage you take, makes you avoid all Stuns and Elemental Ailments, and prevents Curses affecting you.

entries.name: Summon Harbinger of Storms
entries.definition: Summons an immortal Harbinger minion. The minion will occasionally apply a Chill or Shock to an enemy that chains to other nearby enemies.

entries.name: Summon Greater Harbinger of Storms
entries.definition: Summons an immortal Harbinger minion. The minion will occasionally apply a Chill or Shock with increased effect to an enemy that chains to other nearby enemies.

entries.name: Summon Harbinger of the Arcane
entries.definition: Summons an immortal Harbinger minion. The minion will occasionally cast Arcane Surge on you, granting increased Cast Speed and Mana Regeneration.

entries.name: Summon Visiting Harbinger of the Arcane
aliases: Summon Visiting Harbinger of the Arcane
entries.definition: Summons an immortal Harbinger minion. The minion has two buff spells it will cast on you: Arcane Surge, granting increased Cast Speed and Mana Regeneration, and a buff that grants Chance to Shock and Lightning Penetration.

entries.name: Summon Greater Harbinger of the Arcane
aliases: Summon Greater Harbinger of the Arcane
entries.definition: Summons an immortal Harbinger minion. The minion has two buff spells it will cast on you: Arcane Surge, granting increased Cast Speed and Mana Regeneration, and a buff that grants Chance to Shock and Lightning Penetration.

entries.name: Summon Harbinger of Time
entries.definition: Summons an immortal Harbinger minion. The minion will occasionally create an aura on you that increases the Action Speed of you, and all allies and enemies near you.

entries.name: Summon Visiting Harbinger of Time
entries.definition: Summons an immortal Harbinger minion. The minion will occasionally create an aura on you that increases the Action Speed of you and all allies near you.

entries.name: Summon Greater Harbinger of Time
entries.definition: Summons an immortal Harbinger minion. The minion will occasionally create an aura on you that increases the Action Speed of you and all allies near you.

entries.name: Tawhoa's Chosen
entries.definition: This skill is triggered when you use a Slam or Strike skill, and summons a Mirage Chieftain who will use that Slam or Strike skill once before dissipating.

entries.name: Summon Sentinel of Radiance
entries.definition: Summons a Sentinel of Radiance which follows you and attacks enemies in melee, while burning enemies around it and taking a portion of damage from hits for you. You can only have one Sentinel of Radiance.

entries.name: Summon Shaper Memory
entries.definition: Consume Remembrance to summon a memory of the Shaper, which will use a skill once before fading away.

entries.name: Summon Spectral Tiger
entries.definition: Summons a Spectral Tiger Companion that attacks nearby enemies and dies after a duration. Each Spectral Tiger grants you a buff that increases Critical Strike Chance, and increases Attack and Cast Speed. If you have the maximum number of them, refreshes the duration and life of an existing one instead.

entries.name: Summon Spectral Wolf
entries.definition: Summons a spectral wolf companion that attacks nearby enemies and dies after a duration. Each spectral wolf grants you a buff that adds damage to your attacks. If you have the maximum number of them, refreshes the duration and life of an existing one instead.

entries.name: Summon Taunting Contraption
entries.definition: Summons a Taunting Contraption that taunts nearby enemies to attack it.

entries.name: Summon Void Spawn
entries.definition: Summon a Void Spawn minion, which casts a lightning projectile spell with a chance to shock enemies.

entries.name: Divine Blessing
entries.definition: Supports aura skills that create permanent auras around you, changing their reservation to a cost and making them temporary. Cannot support banner or stance skills.

entries.name: Earthbreaker
entries.definition: Supports slam skills, causing them to summon an ancestor totem that uses the skill for you while you're near it. Being near it grants you increased area of effect for melee skills.

entries.name: Eclipse
entries.definition:
Supports any skill gem.
Cannot support skills that don't come from gems.

entries.name: Elemental Penetration
entries.definition: Supports any skill that hits enemies, making those hits penetrate enemy elemental resistances.

entries.name: Tentacle Whip
entries.definition: This attack causes three otherworldly tentacles to strike the ground around you, each dealing your attack damage in an area.

entries.name: Thirst for Blood
entries.definition: Reserves some of your life to cause bleeding you inflict to be stronger, and grant life regeneration based on the number bleeding enemies nearby.

entries.name: Summon Spirit of Ahuana
entries.definition: Summons an immortal chieftain minion of the Ramako tribe to fight alongside you for a duration. This minion grants you a buff which prevents additional damage from suppressed spells. Shares a Cooldown with other Spirit Chieftain Skills.

entries.name: Summon Spirit of Akoya
entries.definition: Summons an immortal chieftain minion of the Tukohama tribe to fight alongside you for a duration. This minion grants you a buff which regenerates rage. Shares a Cooldown with other Spirit Chieftain Skills.

entries.name: Summon Spirit of Ikiaho
entries.definition: Summons an immortal chieftain minion of the Arohongui tribe to fight alongside you for a duration. This minion grants you a buff which makes travel skills recover cooldowns faster. Shares a Cooldown with other Spirit Chieftain Skills.

entries.name: Summon Spirit of Kahuturoa
entries.definition: Summons an immortal chieftain minion of the Rongokurai tribe to fight alongside you for a duration. This minion grants you a buff which lets a percentage of your armour protect against all damage types. Shares a Cooldown with other Spirit Chieftain Skills.

entries.name: Summon Spirit of Kaom
entries.definition: Summons an immortal chieftain minion of the Ngamahu tribe to fight alongside you for a duration. This minion grants you a buff which allows totems to take some damage from hits for you. Shares a Cooldown with other Spirit Chieftain Skills.

entries.name: Summon Spirit of Kiloava
entries.definition: Summons an immortal chieftain minion of the Valako tribe to fight alongside you for a duration. This minion grants you a buff which recovers life, mana and energy shield when you block. Shares a Cooldown with other Spirit Chieftain Skills.

entries.name: Summon Spirit of Maata
entries.definition: Summons an immortal chieftain minion of the Tawhoa tribe to fight alongside you for a duration. This minion grants you a buff which refills flasks. Shares a Cooldown with other Spirit Chieftain Skills.

entries.name: Summon Spirit of Rakiata
entries.definition: Summons an immortal chieftain minion of the Tasalio tribe to fight alongside you for a duration. This minion grants you a buff which prevents your action speed being lowered. Shares a Cooldown with other Spirit Chieftain Skills.

entries.name: Summon Spirit of Tawhanuku
entries.definition: Summons an immortal chieftain minion of the Hinekora tribe to fight alongside you for a duration. This minion grants you a buff which regenerates mana. Shares a Cooldown with other Spirit Chieftain Skills.

entries.name: Summon Spirit of Utula
entries.definition: Summons an immortal chieftain minion of the Kitava tribe to fight alongside you for a duration. This minion grants you a buff which makes a percentage of your leech recover instantly. Shares a Cooldown with other Spirit Chieftain Skills.

entries.name: Fleshrend
entries.definition: Fires a projectile that turns towards enemies in front of it. The projectile does not hit enemies, but as it travels it applies a short physical damage over time debuff to each enemy in an area around it, stacking up to 3 times. The debuff also increases the damage over time they take from all sources.

entries.name: Consecrate
entries.definition: Creates an area of Consecrated Ground, providing life regeneration and reducing the effect of curses for you and allies who stand in it.

entries.name: Heaven's Scourge
entries.definition: A bolt of Beidat's lightning strikes an area, dealing lightning damage.

entries.name: Molten Burst
entries.definition: Launch molten projectiles from the point of impact, causing AoE attack damage to enemies where they land.

entries.name: Shock Ground
entries.definition: Creates a patch of Shocked Ground in a radius around you.

entries.name: Starfall
entries.definition:
Stars fall, raining destruction down over an area. Falling stars deal Attack Damage.
Cannot be Supported by Trigger Support Gems.

entries.name: Triggered Summon Phantasm
entries.definition: Summons a Phantasm minion, which uses a piercing projectile spell that deals physical damage.

entries.name: Create Lesser Shrine
entries.definition: Creates a Lesser Shrine, which will grant a bonus when touched. The Lesser Shrine will disappear after a short duration, or when used. This skill starts on cooldown.

entries.name: Twister
entries.definition: Launches an unpredictable, piercing twister projectile that moves randomly for a duration, repeatedly dealing damage to enemies it intersects.

entries.name: Unhinge
entries.definition: Relinquish your grip on reality.

entries.name: Commandment of Inferno
entries.definition: Drops a meteor from above on a nearby foe, dealing fire damage in an area around them.

entries.name: Reflection
entries.definition: When you attack with The Saviour and deal a critical strike, this skill can summon a Mirage Saviour. Summoned Mirage Saviours will fight for you using whichever of your attack skills you dealt the critical strike with that caused them to be summoned. Mirage Saviours will not be resummoned using the same skills if you already have the maximum number of them.

entries.name: Unseen Strike
entries.definition: Launches a spinning blade that deals weapon damage to enemies. If firing multiple projectiles, they will be fired in a circle.

entries.name: Vaal Breach
entries.definition: This skill is temporarily disabled and cannot be used.

entries.name: Void Gaze
entries.definition: Applies a debuff to Enemies, removing some of their resistance to Chaos damage.

entries.name: Void Shot
entries.definition: Fires an arrow which decelerates to the target location, the arrow will then become unstable and explode dealing weapon damage in an area, converting half of the physical damage to cold damage.

entries.name: Summon Volatile Anomaly
entries.definition: Creates an orb which moves towards nearby enemies, exploding after a duration or when it gets close enough. The explosion deals cold spell damage in an area, and leaves behind a Vortex on the ground for a secondary duration which continues to deal cold damage over time and chill enemies caught in it.

entries.name: Ward Shatter
entries.definition: Your ward shatters, dealing physical spell damage to enemies in an area, based on the amount of ward you have. Enemies hit are inflicted with Enervation, a Debuff that lowers Movement Speed by 20% and prevents Life and Energy Shield Recovery for 4 seconds.

entries.name: Buff Effect
entries.definition: Changes the strength of the applicable buff’s effects. The modifier must specify which buff or buffs it affects.

entries.name: No Reservation
entries.definition: The specified skill reserves none of its usual resource. This does not by itself change other costs of the skill.

entries.name: Armour
entries.definition: A defence that reduces physical damage from hits. Its effectiveness depends on the size of the physical hit relative to your armour; it does not reduce physical damage over time.

entries.name: Attack Speed
entries.definition: Affects how quickly attack skills are performed. Most attacks derive their base attack time from the equipped weapon; action speed is a separate factor.

entries.name: Burning Ground
entries.definition: A damaging ground effect that deals fire damage over time. Burning ground is distinct from ignite; its damage depends on the source.

entries.name: Cast Speed
entries.definition: Affects how quickly spells are cast. Increasing cast speed reduces cast time; this does not by itself reduce a skill’s cooldown.

entries.name: Chaos Resistance
entries.definition: Resistance applied to incoming chaos damage. Elemental resistance modifiers do not grant chaos resistance; modifiers to all resistances include it.

entries.name: Cold Resistance
entries.definition: Resistance applied to incoming cold damage, including hits and damage over time. Its benefit is limited by maximum resistance.

entries.name: Critical Strike
entries.definition: A hit whose damage is multiplied by the critical strike multiplier. Damage over time does not hit and cannot critically strike.

entries.name: Elemental Resistance
entries.definition: A modifier to elemental resistances affects fire, cold and lightning resistance. It does not affect chaos resistance.

entries.name: Energy Shield
entries.definition: A defence that generally absorbs damage before life and can recharge after a period without taking damage. Special mechanics can bypass or change how it protects life.

entries.name: Evasion
entries.definition: A defence checked against an attacker’s accuracy to determine whether an attack hit is evaded. It does not evade spell hits.

entries.name: Fire Resistance
entries.definition: Resistance applied to incoming fire damage, including hits and damage over time. The maximum resistance limits the benefit; resistance is distinct from damage reduction.

entries.name: Life
entries.definition: The health resource of a character or monster. Reaching zero life normally causes death.

entries.name: Lightning Resistance
entries.definition: Resistance applied to incoming lightning damage, including hits and damage over time. Its benefit is limited by maximum resistance.

entries.name: Maximum Life
entries.definition: The upper limit of the life resource before effects such as reservation. This is distinct from your current amount of life.

entries.name: Movement Speed
entries.definition: Determines how fast an entity moves by running. Action speed is a separate modifier that also affects movement animations.

entries.name: Physical Damage
entries.definition: One of the five damage types. Armour mitigates physical damage from hits; it does not mitigate physical damage over time such as bleeding.

entries.name: Recently
entries.definition: Refers to the past four seconds.

entries.name: Reservation
entries.definition: Sets aside part of a resource, usually mana or life, while an ongoing skill is active. The reserved portion is unavailable for other uses; reservation does not lower the resource’s maximum.

entries.name: Stun
entries.definition: An interruption caused by a hit that briefly stops an entity from acting. Stun chance depends on the hit damage relative to the target’s stun threshold.

entries.name: Stun Threshold
entries.definition: The effective life value against which hit damage is compared when determining stun chance. Reducing an enemy’s stun threshold makes a given hit more likely to stun.

entries.name: Unaffected
entries.definition: The specified effect can still be present on you, but has no effect on you. This differs from immunity, which prevents or removes the specified effect.

entries.name: Armour
entries.definition: Armour is a form of defence that mitigates incoming physical damage from hits. Armour can implicitly appear on equipment, much like evasion, energy shield, and ward. Armour rating can be increased by wearing equipment, taking certain passive skills, using skills (e.g. and ), and drinking flasks (e.g. and ).

entries.name: List of unique monsters
entries.definition: Unique Monsters are special monsters with fixed modifiers that appear always in the same zone.
